name: Fuel pump
note: Check: the recorded Pegasus link (RecId 8118) is a Facet cylindrical pump FAC-476459 (6-8 psi, 32 GPH), not a Carter P4070 - read the number off the pump on the car. Carter's instruction sheet (datasheets/PT007) asks for a 10 A fuse, 14 AWG wire, an inlet filter, and mounting no more than 24 in above the top of the tank.

name: Fuel pressure regulator
note: Pegasus product 1135 is the Holley 1-4 psi carburetted regulator (Holley 12-804 by its range and 3/8 NPT ports - check the number on the body): dead-head type, no return port, factory preset about 2.7 psi. Holley instruction 199R7914-3 is in datasheets/PT008.

name: Fuel filter
support: AutoZone (Duralast) help via autozone.com - number not verified
note: FF3429DL is the Duralast equivalent of the factory E508-13-470 cartridge (cross-reference list: Luber-Finer G803 direct, Wix 33066/33204, Fram G4775/G6458, Purolator F23170, Motorcraft FG803). AutoZone's page refuses automated reads, so inlet/outlet size is not recorded - check the filter.

name: Fuel cut-off
note: The Amazon listing is an ERYUE 'First Inertia Switch' crash sensor - a Ford-style inertia switch that opens the electric fuel pump circuit on impact, not a valve. Check the fitted unit, its reset button location and where it sits in the Carter pump feed.

name: Fuel line, 3/8 in
note: HOUSUN 3/8 in ID NBR fuel hose, 300 psi rated, sold as 10 ft with 10 clamps.

name: Vacuum lines and fittings
note: Includes the brake booster and transmission vacuum fittings

name: Ignition coils, leading and trailing
note: Genuine Mazda coils are no longer made; Atkins sells an aftermarket NGK coil under 8245-18-100 for all 1980-85 12A/13B. S-001 Section B: trailing coil B-18 (BW +, YG -), leading coil B-19 (BW +, YL -); check on the car.

name: Distributor
note: Breakerless, with the igniters on its housing Leading timing is set by rotating the housing on its lock nut, trailing timing by moving the trailing vacuum unit on its screws (S-002 p.5-36, S-006 p.44). Atkins lists a rebuilt 1981-85 unit as N249-18-200A (NLA).

name: Distributor cap
note: Atkins sells 8245-24-310B for all 1980-85 rotaries at 57.00 USD; Mazdatrix lists it as 24-310B-8245 at 58.32 USD.

name: Distributor rotor
note: Standard Motor Products JR87 crosses to 8245-24-303A (RockAuto).

name: Spark plug wires
note: The 16,000 ohm +/-40% lead limit is per 1 m (39.37 in) of lead (S-002 p.5-37). On 1981 cars the leading leads had black boots and the trailing leads blue (S-006 p.44); check on the car.

name: Spark plugs
note: NGK stock number for BR8EQ-14 is 2329.

name: Radiator
note: Automatic car: the radiator carries the transmission oil-cooler hoses, which come off before the radiator (1985 FSM removal order). New factory radiators are no longer available (Atkins lists 79-82 8341-15-310 as NLA); our catalogue number N202-15-310B - check the replacement matches the automatic's cooler fittings.

name: Water pump
note: Aftermarket pumps listed for this car: GMB 145-1180, Dayco DP1279, Beck/Arnley 131-1937, US Motor Works US9053. Check which catalogue item these replace: Atkins sells the pump as N232-99-153B, the successor of the cover part N232-99-153A.

name: Thermostat
note: Atkins' 180 F rotary thermostat 8553-15-171 lists 8553-99-152 among the numbers it replaces. Fit it with the jiggle pin at the top.

name: Water temperature gauge sender
note: Works Single-wire resistive sender (YW) under the oil filter stand, grounding through its thread; M8x0.75 straight thread sealed with a crush washer.

name: Battery
note: Lead-acid, in the factory location The 1982 workshop manual (S-038 p.T:3) lists NS70S, 55 Ah (20 h), 12 V negative ground as the battery for an automatic car outside California; S.G. 1.280 fully charged, recharge at 1.220. A modern JIS NS70 is 259 x 173 x 223 mm with SAE taper posts; measure the tray before buying (check).

name: Alternator
note: Its rating has not been read off the car Internal: 3-phase star stator into a 6-diode bridge (B) plus a 3-diode trio (L), 2-brush rotor field, Mitsubishi-type IC regulator with R (BW, IG sense) and L (WB) on a 2-pin coupler and an F test hole in the rear housing (S-001 p.10, S-002 p.5-6). Direct replacements carry OE N22118300 with Mitsubishi A2T/A3T/A5T numbers (WAI 12278N 50 A new; Pure Energy 14550 55 A reman).

name: Starter motor
note: 1982 Technical Data (S-038 T:3) confirms the A/T starter at 2.0 kW with 4 brushes. A/T replacements: Pure Energy / Remy / TerrePower 16717, interchange N20218400(A/B) and Mitsubishi M2T50581.

name: Wiring harness
note: Previous-owner splices; one known instance is the dash behind the head unit and factory amplifier S-001 p30: the front harness meets the engine harness at X-01, the in-panel harness at X-02 and X-12, and the rear harness at X-03; body grounds are X-13 (LH suspension tower and under the dash LH), X-14 and X-15. Wire colours are base then tracer (GY = green/yellow; Lg = light green).

name: Wideband O2 gauge and sensor
note: Taps into the factory harness at a point not yet located

name: Interval wiper control unit
note: On the 1982 car the intermittent (INT) wiper timer is not a separate box: S-001 section D p18 draws it inside the Control Processing Unit (PT301, connector X-16), and the 1985 manual calls it the intermittent wiper relay (in the CPU); its terminals are recorded on PT301 (A, B, F, H, J, L). Check whether any separate unit exists on the car.

name: Hatch release solenoid
note: The hatch latch switch is broken Catalogue name is 'opener, remote control' 8341-62-315, GS and GSL only, one per car, figure 6230A-1 (S-005 Body-Index p.92, row BI-092-10 by list order). S-001 p.26: two wires, GR from the H-13 dash switch and B to ground X-15, on the 20 A constant fuse shared with the fuel-door release. Owners report the internal rubber bumpers crumble and jam the pinion; the unit unbolts (rod off the latch, two screws in its rubber boot), bends open at its tabs and cleans up; 1981-85 units interchange (rx7club thread). No new or used listing found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

name: Fuel-door solenoid
note: Catalogue name is 'opener, filler lid' FA01-42-480 with its bracket 8871-42-490 (S-005 numeric index, group 4200A-1). S-001 p.26: two wires, GB from the H-15 dash switch and B to ground X-15, 20 A constant fuse shared with the hatch release. Manual release: behind the left rear speaker cover or under the cargo carpet, a slide at the top of the mechanism pushed rearward (or the metal tab on the solenoid) drops the lid; never pry the lid from outside (rx7club thread). No listing found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

name: Power mirror heads
note: Each is one reversible motor plus an electromagnetic clutch coil that selects the axis; the factory mirror switch is dead S-001 p.28 drawing: each head is one reversible motor across Lg and LgB and one axis-select solenoid across LgY and B; the LH head's LgY runs straight from the switch through I-02, the RH head's solenoid wire is LgR in the dash harness and becomes LgY at I-04 in the door. Feed WG on the 10 A constant fuse at X-04, ground B via X-02 to X-13. Catalogue: remote-control type 8341-69-110A (R) and 8341-69-170A (L) for GS and GSL, held by four screws 8341-69-178 (S-005 Body-Index p.128). Atkins Rotary stocks no 79-85 side mirrors; used power heads are on Hollander (about 45-50 USD, 2026-09-27).

name: Headlamp retractor motors, LH and RH
note: DC motors with up and down limit switches; both manual raise knobs work S-001 p.20: each motor unit holds a cam limit switch with UP/DOWN diodes and a relay; the relay switches WR to the motor and grounds it (brakes) at rest, and YG lights the 3.4 W retractor indicator while it runs. The motors take their own 0.3 sq fusible link on WR.

name: Rear defrost grid
note: Not measured Grid G-25: LG feed from the switch, B return through D-07 (or X-18 without rear wiper) to ground X-15 (S-001 p24). Test: about 6 V at the centre of each filament with the switch on; repair broken lines with silver paint 2835-77-600.

name: Washer fluid pump
note: Not working; the cause is not diagnosed Still sold new as 8532-76-672: Mazdatrix lists it at 48.39 USD, Atkins at 99 USD. The same pump fits 1979-94 RX-7s and many other Mazdas. S-001 feeds it from the IG 10 A LB fuse, and the combination switch grounds its LY wire. To diagnose, put 12 V across the pump and see if it runs; if it does, the fault is in the circuit (the switch contact tab is the known 1st-gen failure).

name: Blower motor
note: Dead - no airflow Aftermarket motor-only replacement: Four Seasons 35483 (interchanges Mazda 8871-76-453 / 8871-76-453A, Cardone reman 44-1064, UAC BM3733, Siemens PM3733); it comes without the fan wheel, so the wheel is moved over from the old motor. Fed from the 20 A BLOWER fuse on the LO wire; speed is set by the resistor pack in the ground side.

name: A/C system
note: Holds charge and barely cools Dealer/port-installed kit: the 1982 catalogue accessory packages 6132AB (condenser), 6142AB (compressor) and 6152AB (evaporator); S-048 is the dealer installation instruction and its p.13 the circuit, S-001 p.24 section G the factory circuit. R-12 system; no factory charge figure found, only forum estimates.

name: A/C belt

name: Front calipers
note: Single-piston floating caliper, the lower attaching bolt comes out and the body pivots up on the upper pin to change pads (S-002 p.11-4). Overhaul is with seal kit 8341-49-240 (in stock at Atkins and Mazdatrix) and the piston comes out with compressed air against a wood block (S-002 p.11-6). The 1983 Mitchell brake article (src-mitchell-1983-brakes) is downloaded to 01-REFERENCE/model/library/datasheets/PT050/.

name: Brake master cylinder
note: Tandem master cylinder with the level-sensor reservoir on top; strips into reservoir set, bushes, joint bolt with check valve and spring, secondary-piston stop bolt and O-ring, stop ring, primary piston, secondary piston and spring (S-002 11-17). On rear-drum cars the check valve goes in with its six-hole face toward the cylinder body (S-002 11-18). Atkins Rotary sells FA07-43-400 new (OEM-quality, 134 USD, in stock, 'fits 12A with drum brakes') and lists FA18-43-400 beside it; an rx7club thread gives FA01-43-400 as the 81-83 S/GS number and FA18-43-400 as GSL, so check the number cast on the car's cylinder. Nisshinbo (Mazda's supplier) makes a limited reproduction, NSB-102, 398 USD via JDM Car Parts. Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.110 (4340A-1).

name: Brake booster
note: FA16-43-800 is NLA at Atkins Rotary (145 USD, out of stock, 'getting very hard to obtain'); the only aftermarket listing found is a PRIOR 9700158 remanufactured unit on RockAuto (1983 listing, out of stock); used OEM boosters are sold by Autopartone, and rx7club owners report local rebuilds (~80 USD) and Cardone remans. The booster-to-firewall gasket H001-43-443 is 1.88 USD at Atkins. Inside: front and rear shells, diaphragm, power piston, valve rod and plunger (serviced only as an assembly), reaction disc, air silencer and filter, push rod, front and rear seals (S-002 11-21..22).

name: Steering gear box
note: Pre-1983: the sector shaft is not hardened, a known wear point Mazda has discontinued every 79-85 steering box (Mazdatrix). Exchange rebuilds: Atkins Rotary ARE850 box-and-column, 750 USD + 150 core, out of stock; Advantage Steering SKU 70409, 1145 USD + 500 core, 3-year warranty. Atkins' listing gives the fill as 0.31 US qt (290 cc), which supports the 290 cc reading of S-038. Removal takes the bonnet off and the box out through the engine bay; Mazda's labour figure was 4 h. Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.94 (3210A-1).

name: Automatic transmission

name: Starting assist cable
note: Drove the factory carburettor, which is gone; confirm whether it is still fitted. also: EC-035-07 8871-13-087A No cold-start hardware remains since the Weber conversion.

note: with bracket set, front and rear lever sets, rod and link set and return springs. also: EC-038-30 N201-23-371, EC-038-27 8341-23-349

note: with pump weight and nozzle set

name: Semi-automatic choke
note: with return choke set and vacuum pipe set

name: Air pump
note: Confirm it is still fitted: the Weber manifold may have dropped the air injection. also: EC-040-01 1757-13-714 Belt-driven vane air pump feeding the air control valve, thermal reactor/port air and the catalyst; the factory test is outlet pressure above 11.5 kPa at 800 rpm with gauge set 49 2113 010B (1980 and 1985 manuals). No new 12A pump found on sale; used units only.

name: Air pump V-belt
note: Check fitted Runs between the water pump pulley and the air pump pulley; tension is set by swinging the pump on its strap bolt. OEM-quality replacement 1757-13-715 in stock at Atkins Rotary (2026-09).

name: Air control valve
note: N201-13-720 is California, N203-13-720 Federal; confirm which, and confirm it is still fitted: the Weber manifold may have dropped the air injection. also: EC-040-08 N201-13-724 The 1981-83 factory ACV holds three valves in one body - the air relief valve, the air switching valve and the No.1 anti-afterburn valve - and is not repairable: it is replaced as a unit (S-006 p72-73, 1981). A block-off plate for 81-91 non-turbo engines (Racing Beat 16325, sold by Atkins Rotary) exists if the air injection has been removed.

name: Air injection check valve
note: The 1981-82 system has two check valves: one for port air (ACV to exhaust port) and one for split air (ACV to the 2-bed catalyst); this part (1480-13-730, figure 1371A-1) is the one on the ACV (S-006 p71-72).

name: Shutter valve actuator (diaphragm)
note: Gasket N201-13-135 California or N203-13-135 Federal; confirm it is still fitted: the Weber manifold may have dropped the air injection. also: EC-041-06 N201-13-135, EC-041-07 N203-13-135, EC-041-08 1480-13-137A, EC-041-09 1480-13-139B, EC-041-05 1480-13-727A; 1380A-2 EC-042-01: see recall campaigns 23702/2370C for emission control The shutter valve on the intake manifold shuts the rear primary port on deceleration while the combined coasting valve lets fresh air into the rear primary port; its diaphragm is worked by manifold vacuum through the yellow-dot shutter solenoid valve, active on deceleration above about 1100 rpm (S-006 p78, p94-95).

name: Three-way solenoid valves (vacuum switching)
note: 4 x 1481-13-240A (the Fed/A-T/Cal row EC-041-11 has no number of its own; it is the variant of EC-041-10) and 1 x 1482-13-240A, on bracket 1480-13-241A; confirm fitted and which are still wired. also: EC-041-14 1480-13-241A Five three-way vacuum solenoid valves, each coded by a coloured dot: air-con/throttle opener white, air relief blue, coasting/shutter yellow, air switching gray, vacuum control (distributor advance cut) orange (S-006 p85). The 1982 wiring diagram feeds each from the emission control unit, with the other pin to ground (S-001 p12).

name: Emission vacuum pipe assembly
note: Confirm fitted

name: Emission vacuum hoses and tubes
note: Bulk hose and tube; vacuum caps 1010-13-104 x 3. also: EC-041-03; check which factory lines remain - replacement lines are PT012

name: Vacuum actuator
note: Confirm fitted and what it drives on this car. also: EC-041-13 8871-13-291A The 1981 layout's vacuum-driven pieces are the shutter valve diaphragm, the throttle opener (pulls the throttle open with the A/C on), two choke diaphragms, the dash pot (M/T) and the distributor advance units (S-006 p66, p93-95); which of them this 'actuator' 3648-13-290 is, the catalogue does not say - check on the car.

name: Anti-afterburn valve
note: with its air hoses; confirm fitted. also: EC-041-26 N201-13-757A This is the No.2 anti-afterburn valve (the No.1 is inside the air control valve): on the first moment of deceleration it lets air from the air cleaner into the rear secondary port (S-006 p77, p95).

name: Vacuum delay valve
note: Confirm fitted The 1981 vacuum routing shows the delay valve in the vacuum line to the No.1 choke diaphragm, which it lets pull the choke further open a few seconds after start (S-006 p82, p108); check that this is where it sits on the car.

name: Altitude compensator
note: N249-20-770 is a marked <A> alternative; it sat on the factory air cleaner - confirm whether it is still fitted. also: EC-041-31 N201-20-771

name: Canister purge valve
note: Check fitted Sits near the oil filler pipe, purging canister vapour into the intake above idle. Atkins lists 1480-20-950A at 79.95 USD but no longer available; Mazda dealer sites still list the number.

name: Accelerator pedal pad
note: Mazdatrix stocks the 79-83 gas pedal pad 8871-41-711B (16.68 USD).

name: Accelerator cable
note: Factory cable, cut; a custom bracket carries a new cable end that attaches to the old bare cable end. Not the catalogued Weber-kit cable (FA01-41-660) — a spliced hybrid, confirmed 2026-09-26. Atkins lists the factory cable FA01-41-660 at 75 USD, out of stock with limited remaining supply.

name: Fuel tank
note: '82 type (serial 525552 on); see parts bulletin T-2-4. also: EC-107-03, EC-107-14 8531-42-761, EC-107-23 8871-12-745, EC-107-31 8871-72-761 No new or reproduction tank exists for the 1981-83 car; used tanks appear on autopartone (349 USD, sold out) and eBay. Removal and hose insertion figures are in the 1985 manual 4A-48/49.

name: Fuel tank bands, left and right
Fuel gauge sender unit
note: also: EC-107-40 8871-60-962A Still sold new by Atkins (129.99 USD, with gasket) and Mazda dealers. Two-wire resistive sender: Y signal to the fuel gauge, B to ground (1982 diagram, connector C-01).

name: Fuel filler pipe
note: also: EC-107-08 0866-42-366B, EC-107-09 8871-42-242A Atkins lists 8871-42-210C at 75 USD, no longer available with a few left; the cap screws straight onto this neck.

name: Fuel filler cap
note: also: EC-107-27 8871-42-365 Atkins stocks the OEM cap 8871-42-250B (21.11 USD). Owners report the stock cap is not vented (the tank vents through the canister) and came branded Gates or Stant; PartsGeek lists Motorad MGC763 as the aftermarket fit.

name: Fuel filler lid
note: also: EC-107-25 FA01-42-431B, EC-107-19 0187-70-491 Catalogue row 42-410 'lid, fuel filler' 8871-42-410A is for the '81 and '82 models; the '83 lid is a different number, FA54-42-410 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.107). Lift spring FA01-42-431B and two stoppers 0187-70-491 (from FB331-500063) sit with it. No new or used FB lid found online (two searches, 2026-09-27).

name: Fuel tank vent check valve
note: also: EC-107-38 8871-42-920 This is the 'check and cut valve' of the evaporative line: it relieves tank pressure or vacuum and stops fuel loss if the car overturns; test pressures are in the specs (1985 manual).

name: Fuel tank vent and breather hoses
note: with breather pipe 8562-42-530

name: Fuel main pipe (steel, tank to engine)
note: also: EC-114-29 8173-45-901A, EC-114-32, EC-114-34 8171-45-903A, EC-114-28 8871-45-715 Runs under the floor from the tank-side fuel pump and filter to the engine bay, held by pipe clips and a pipe protector (catalogue figure 4500A-1). No reproduction steel line for the 1981-82 carburetted car was found; Inline Tube makes only the 1984-85 GSL-SE main line (5/16 in).

name: Fuel return pipe (steel)
note: Carries surplus fuel from the carburettor back to the tank; the factory manuals show the return hose on the tank fitting beside the main hose.

name: Evaporation pipes (steel)
note: Carries tank vapour forward to the charcoal canister through the check and cut valve (1985 manual 4A-3 schematic); leak test is the U-tube pressure test in the specs.

name: Fuel hoses, tank and pump
note: Rubber hoses joining the steel pipes to the tank, fuel pump, filter and fuel cut valve; all are pushed fully onto their fittings and secured with clips.

name: Fuel cut valve (factory)
note: Factory valve in the fuel piping; check whether the fuel cut-off PT010 is this valve or a separate part. also: EC-114-12 8871-45-131A Bolted on its own bracket in the feed line after the fuel pump, with a 'from fuel pump' inlet and a 'to carburetor' outlet marked by arrows on the body (1980 and 1985 manuals). Mazda still lists 3919-45-170A, shared with B-series trucks and the 626.

name: Radiator cap
note: 13 psi cap. Atkins sells 8871-15-205 new (79-85 12A, not 84-85 13B); aftermarket 13 psi equivalents listed for this car include Gates 31527 and Motorad T13.

name: Radiator hose, upper
note: Atkins lists 8871-15-511 (79-82 12A) as out of stock; Racing Beat silicone kit 11480 (upper and lower hoses plus 4 clamps) replaces both hoses.

name: Radiator hose, lower
note: Atkins lists 8871-15-521 (79-82 12A) as out of stock; Racing Beat silicone kit 11480 covers it.

name: Water pump shaft bearings
note: The bearing is pressed in by its outer race and held by a snap ring.

name: Water pump seal

name: Water pump baffle plate
note: check: 0118-15-125 up to serial FB331 618134, N201-15-125A from 618135; read the VIN serial

note: Sold new only in aluminium as Atkins N232-99-153B (replaces N232-99-153A and 3648-15-130), with the pump gasket; the housing-to-block gasket is separate. Cast-iron versions are no longer made.
