note: Comes off the shaft in a press, using Mazda adapter 49 1975 145 bolted to the boss.

name: Water pump pulley
note: No longer available from Mazda. Atkins makes an aluminium reproduction (1757-15-151B-ARE).

name: Cooling fan and fan drive
note: on the water pump pulley boss; pulley spacer 8872-15-211

name: Fan drive (viscous coupling)
note: N201-15-210B (81-83 12A) is no longer available (NLA at Atkins). The 84-85 12A clutch is N249-15-210B; no source says it interchanges.

name: Thermostat cover
note: Atkins stocks 8872-15-170A (all 81-85 12A) and says housing 1757-15-172 also fits.

name: Coolant sub tank
note: bracket FA01-56-374; clip 8156-18-863B Round bottle. Its successor 1052-15-350D replaces 1052-15-350B and is sold new by Atkins. Check the level with the engine cold: it should sit between the FULL and LOW marks.

name: Engine oil cooler
note: below the radiator; clip 3565-14-662A (oil group, where it holds is not stated - check) New 8871-14-700A is no longer available (Atkins Rotary lists it NLA, 79-82 12A); the thermo pellet PT199 comes fitted in new coolers.

name: Oil cooler thermo pellet (bypass valve)
note: note               with spring 1757-14-821, stopper nut 1757-14-822, gasket 9956-42-200. The catalogue print reads 8871-?4-810; 14 read from the group - check Atkins Rotary sells 8871-14-810 new (Mazda, with crush washer) as fitting all 1979-91 RX-7s, which settles the catalogue's unreadable digit as 14.

name: Oil cooler hose (1011-14-720)
note: protector 0813-14-716; union joints 9938-41-200F x2 Available new as the 79-82 12A short oil cooler line (Atkins Rotary, Mazda 1011-14-720); a steel-braided line kit (Atkins 11907) also exists for 79-82 12A.

name: Oil cooler hose (8871-14-730)
note: connector 9938-11-400; bracket 8871-14-742; clip 0839-14-745A Available new as the 79-82 12A long oil cooler line (Atkins Rotary, Mazda 8871-14-730).

name: Heater unit
note: service hole cover 0810-56-639 The 1985 workshop manual (Section 15, p15-79) has an exploded view of the heater unit, blower unit and ducts; the 1985 dash differs, so use it for layout only.

name: Heater case
note: two halves; cover 8871-76-418; plate 8871-76-404; clamps 8871-76-466 x6

name: Heater core
note: The Mazda core 8871-76-402 is no longer available (Atkins Rotary). The Brassworks makes a copper replacement to order for 1979-85 LHD cars, about 12 to 14 weeks.

name: Heater water valve
note: Genuine Mazda valve 8871-76-409 fits every 1979-85 12A and 13B car; Atkins Rotary lists it again (Mazda re-released it), stock varies. Mazdatrix lists it as NLA.

name: Heater unit control levers and guides
Heater hose no. 1
note: Engine-to-firewall heater hose, 1979-82 12A and 1984-85 13B; still sold new as genuine Mazda (Atkins Rotary, Mazdatrix).

name: Heater hose no. 2
note: Heater (at the firewall) to heater pipe hose, all 1979-85; still sold new as genuine Mazda.

name: Heater hose no. 3
note: Heater pipe to radiator hose, 1979-82 only; discontinued by Mazda (Atkins, Mazdatrix). Atkins says it takes hose clamp 9928-22-600. The 1983-85 hose FA42-61-213A is still sold but belongs to the '83 pipe.

name: Heater pipe
note: protector 1011-61-216; firewall grommets 8871-61-219A x2 Steel pipe that joins heater hose no. 2 to hose no. 3 (pipe to radiator); the 1979-82 pipe F001-61-220B is not the same as the '83 FA42-61-220C.

name: Blower-to-heater duct (cars without A/C)
note: Listed for cars without A/C; the car has A/C (PT040), where the evaporator case takes this place - confirm. Its drain plugs 0187-53-134, 0118-56-241, B499-62-868 and hole plug 1708-61-031 are also without-A/C only

name: Heater control panel
note: check: FA01-61-190 up to serial FB331 633360 (thru Jan 82), FA01-61-190A from 633361; read the VIN serial. The internal parts below are listed for FA01-61-190 only. Small parts: bushings 8871-76-516, 8871-76-518, 8531-76-415; snap ring 0259-71-158; washers 0315-76-028 x2, 8871-76-517; plate 8871-76-503A; bracket F001-76-500A; bearing covers 8871-76-509, 8871-76-512; spring 8871-76-510; steel balls 8871-76-511, 8871-76-514; spacer 8871-76-513; pin 8871-76-515 Three controls: a mode lever (REC/MAX, VENT, BI-LEVEL, HEAT, DEF), a temperature lever (COLD to HOT) and a rotary fan knob (OFF, L, M, HI) with the A/C push switch. This layout is shown on the 1980 panel (1980 workshop manual Fig. 15-33); check it against this car's panel.

name: Heater control knobs
note: knob no. 1 x2, knob, A/C knob; the A/C knob is listed without A/C fitment and the car has A/C (PT040) - check it is on the panel

name: Heater control illumination bulb
note: Factory ref E-06, fed on RL from the panel dimmer and grounded on B; the 1.4 W rating is already recorded. Trade number not found: check it on the bulb.

name: Blower fan switch
note: listed as a part of FA01-61-190; check on the car which control panel is fitted Rotary 4-position switch (OFF, LO, MI, HI) that switches the blower's ground through the resistor taps. It also contains the A/C push switch and a 1.4 W A/C indicator lamp, so the A/C works only when the fan is on.

name: Heater control levers (selector, temperature)
note: listed as parts of FA01-61-190; check which control panel is fitted

name: Heater control cables
note: cable clamps 8562-76-508, 8871-76-508 x2. Listed as parts of FA01-61-190; check which control panel is fitted Adjusting (1985 manual, other panel): set the mode to VENT, pull the heater-unit mode lever fully rearward and clamp the wire. For temperature, set COLD MAX, push the heater-unit selector lever down (COLD) and clamp, then check it travels fully from COLD to HOT.

name: Heater blower unit
note: packing 8871-76-465; gaskets 8871-76-454, 8871-76-458; screws 8871-76-455 x3; washer 0866-76-471; collar 8871-76-462 Under the passenger side of the dash. It holds the motor, fan, resistor pack and the fresh/recirculation door.

name: Blower fan case
note: upper and lower case; flange 8871-76-452

name: Blower fan wheel
note: The catalogue names 8871-76-456 (key 76 424A) MOTOR, FAN, next to the motor 8871-76-453A; read here as the fan wheel on the motor shaft - check. held by nut 3794-76-426 and washers 0866-76-475, 0866-76-476, listed up to serial FB331 618727 - check Aftermarket motors (Four Seasons 35483) come without a wheel, so this wheel is moved over to the new motor.

name: Blower resistor
note: Mazda 8871-76-457 is no longer available (Atkins Rotary). A wire-wound pack in the blower unit under the passenger dash. On A/C cars the first stage is shorted, so HI runs the motor with no resistance. Owners report that 40-year-old packs go open-circuit; rx7club suggests the 1986 Mazda 626 or 323 pack as a donor (unverified).

name: Blower wiring
note: Carries the blower unit's 4-pin connector G-14 (LO, LR, LY, LW), which links the dash harness to the motor and the resistor taps.

name: A/C compressor bracket and strap (factory listing)
note: check: the '82 A/C package lists its own compressor mounting 0000-67-C10A-4A; check which bracket is on the car No new or reproduction bracket found; used OEM 12A compressor brackets are sold for 1984-85 cars (e.g. https://www.autopartone.com/products/84-85-mazda-rx7-oem-12a-a-c-compressor-bracket), fit to the '82 engine not checked. Listing sold out on 2026-09-25 (USD 75).

name: A/C compressor mounting and adjusting arms
note: '82 A/C package: mounting, front and rear adjusting arms, adapter kit. Fasteners: bolt sack kit 0000-67-5409-02; bolts 0000-67-X10M-13, 0000-67-1983-70, 0000-67-1981-79 x2, 0000-67-X10M-25, 0000-67-6716-17, 0000-67-X10A-06; nuts 0000-67-1983-77 x5, 0000-67-1983-76; lockwashers 0000-67-1976-92, 0000-67-X40A-01, 0000-67-X40M-03 x8; flatwashers 0000-67-0970-17 x6; spacers 0000-67-1983-69 x2. Check against the factory bracket 8562-15-921 The Mazda dealer A/C installation instruction (S-048, year not stated) shows this kit as mount MZ-97-A-1 bolted to the engine on two 3/8 in spacers, the compressor hung from it on a 3/8 x 5 in bolt at the bottom and two 3/8 x 1-1/2 in bolts in the top adjusting slots; the rear adjusting-arm bolt also carries the spark plug wire holder. Listing is a used 84-85 bracket; check fit. Listing sold out on 2026-09-25 (USD 75).

name: A/C compressor and clutch (Sankyo)
note: assembly Sankyo 9157; compressor alone Sankyo 1573. Shaft key 0000-67-0127-16; O-ring set 0000-67-0123-40 Sankyo SD-508 family (Sanden today: 5-cylinder wobble plate, 138 cc, R-12; the R-134a successor is SD5H14); replacement Four Seasons 58033 is a new SD508 with clutch and 5-1/4 in pulley for dealer-installed A/C. S-049 (1980 compressor repair manual) covers the Nippondenso 6P134 swash-plate compressor, not this one. Hose fittings point upward when mounted (S-048 p.2).

name: A/C compressor clutch
note: accessory kit 0000-67-0234-00 (key 111, with the clutch parts) Clutch lead wire loops through the open hole in the compressor body so it cannot touch the pulley; it takes the black wire from the A/C relay (S-048 p.9 step 31). Sanden SD-series clutch service values (air gap, shims, torques) are recorded as replacement specs.

name: A/C clutch front plate and rotor
note: Replacement compressor Four Seasons 58033 carries a 5-1/4 in diameter single-groove pulley; check the pulley diameter on the car.

name: A/C condenser
note: sack kit 0000-67-1478-05; brackets 0000-67-0007-44 x2 (R), 0000-67-0007-45 x2 (L); tapping screws 0000-67-X30A-01 x14 Mounted in front of the radiator inside the cowling: two studs on the passenger-side bracket take 1/4 in kepnuts, the driver side takes two 1/4-20 x 1/2 bolts (S-048 p.3, S-005 p.81). Inlet (3/8 in fitting) at top left when laid flat; left brackets at holes 1-2 and 6-7, right brackets at holes 1-2 and 9-10 from the top (S-048 p.2 step 7). Reproduction made on OE tooling: Auto AC Solutions, replaces 67128508.

name: A/C receiver-drier
note: mounting bracket 0000-67-0011-83; grommets 0000-67-A43A-6F, 0000-67-A44A-6F x2; check where it is mounted Held to its bracket by two bands and two #10-32 x 1/2 screws with kepnuts, bracket to the radiator cowling with two 1/4 in kepnuts (S-048 p.3-4). Four Seasons 33234 (3/8 in flare in/out, switch port, 2.5 x 8 in) is listed for 1981-82 RX-7.

name: A/C low pressure switch
note: on the receiver-drier Catalogue calls it the low pressure switch on the receiver-drier (S-005 p.81). In S-001 it is G-21 'refrigerant pressure switch' (YL/YR) in series between the No.1 air-con relay and the frost switch; the dealer circuit drawing (S-048 p.13) shows no pressure switch, so check which wiring the car has.

name: A/C liquid hose, condenser to receiver-drier
note: Attached to the condenser at about 45 degrees upward toward the front of the car (S-048 p.2 step 8).

name: A/C liquid hose, receiver-drier to evaporator
note: Routed through a hole in the upper right of the radiator cowling with a grommet, clamped to the lip of the front body panel (#6 clamp, #10-32 screw), to the wheel well by the overflow tank (drilled 1/4 in hole) and to the forward inside stud of the shock tower (8 mm nut); must clear the headlight door mechanism by at least 2 in (S-048 p.10).

name: A/C suction and discharge hose assembly
note: with tube block 0000-67-1978-02 (bolt 0000-67-6716-50); hose O-ring set 0000-67-0123-38. Hose routing parts: protectors 0000-67-1977-07, 0000-67-1977-09; clamps 0000-67-1998-14 x2, 0000-67-1998-13, 0000-67-0007-47, 0000-67-A46A-3F; firewall clamp-brackets 0000-67-0011-61 (R), 0000-67-0011-62 (L); ty-raps 0000-67-X60A-00 x4; nuts, washers, screws, bolts 0000-67-1981-86, -1983-82, -1997-59, -1982-33, -1997-24, -0402-83, -1997-27 Discharge line passes through the hole in the radiator cowling on the driver's side nearest the radiator with a foam protector, is clamped (#8 clamp) to a stand-off bracket and to the frame by the battery box (6 mm bolt), and runs under the car harness to the compressor. Suction hose: 110-degree fitting at the evaporator, 45-degree fitting at the compressor, routed under the hot-start assist cable, clamped by the hood latch (S-048 p.4-5, p.11).

name: A/C wire harness (engine bay)
note: cord clip 0000-67-1978-35; harness clamp 0000-67-1977-89 Dealer harness: a white coupler that plugs into the car's OEM coupler (BW and LR wires), a black wire to the compressor clutch, and yellow and blue wires along the firewall to the evaporator harness, tie-wrapped to the hood release cable and the brake vacuum line (S-048 p.9).

name: A/C evaporator unit
note: between the blower and the heater unit. Evaporator screw kit 0000-67-1478-36; retainer clips 0000-67-1977-25 x8; screws, washers, nuts 0000-67-1982-26, -0402-83, -0411-12, -1983-78 Sits between the blower outlet and heater inlet behind the glove box; top case bracket hangs on a stud on the upper dash panel (6 mm nut), lower brackets bolt to the firewall (6 mm nuts), metal seal plates bridge to blower and heater (S-048 p.6-8). A micro-switch on the heater (adjusted so the compressor is off in heat and defrost) and a white short connector on the blower terminals are part of the installation (S-048 p.6-7).

name: A/C evaporator case (top, bottom, transition)
note: top and bottom cases carry the same number in the catalogue; brackets 0000-67-0008-79 (top), bottom bracket unnumbered; seals 0000-67-0007-42, 0000-67-0007-41 Injection moulded (S-005 p.90).

name: A/C expansion valve
note: externally equalised; O-ring 0000-67-0123-21; bulb clamp 0000-67-B44A-3B Catalogue: 'valve, expansion - extension equalizer' with capillary bulb clamp No.1 (S-005 p.90). Aftermarket crosses for 67-0336-81: Four Seasons 38611, ACDelco 15-5768, A-Premium APAEV208.

name: A/C thermostat (frost) switch
note: mounting bracket 0000-67-0007-37 Catalogue: 'switch, thermostat - preset frosting', i.e. a fixed-setting frost switch on its own bracket (S-005 p.90). S-001 G-22 'frost warning temp switch' LG/YR; in the dealer circuit two yellow wires between relay terminal 5 and the heater micro-switch (S-048 p.13).

name: A/C relay
note: Listed in the evaporator package but mounted in the engine bay on an existing screw; if a relay is already there it is turned so the OEM relay tucks under the bracket (S-048 p.9 step 28). Four terminals 1, 3, 4, 5 in the dealer drawing; the factory diagram calls it G-18 No.1 air-con relay (LB, LR, YL, BW).

name: A/C evaporator wire harnesses
note: two harnesses and a jumper wire; wire connector 0000-67-1998-83 Blue and yellow wires pass through the firewall (pushed out only to the yellow tape, about 2 in) to meet the relay wires; yellow and green spade terminals go to the heater micro-switch; a green female bullet and a blue male bullet splice into the blower motor's blue/green-stripe wires (S-048 p.7-9).

name: A/C evaporator drain hose
note: elbow 0000-67-1995-30; clamp 0000-67-1988-67; grommets 0000-67-1992-98, 0000-67-B62A-4A Grommet in the firewall, 90-degree elbow pushed through from the engine side, hose cut to length at the evaporator drain port and clamped; a hole is cut in the carpet at the drain tube (S-048 p.12).

name: Resistor on bracket (engine bay)
note: Sold as the bracket with the resistor block; which circuit it serves is not stated on the figure - check on the car The catalogue figure (S-005 1800A-1, item 18590) draws the bracket carrying a two-unit plug-in block; no source read names the circuit - check on the car.

name: Distributor pick-up coil set
note: Two numbers listed; which is fitted is unknown - check N236-24-314 is sold as pick-up coil and breaker plate for all 1981-85 RX-7 (Atkins 330.00 USD, out of stock; Mazdatrix 253.86 USD). Each pick-up coil's two leads run straight into its igniter (S-001 Section B).

name: Distributor signal rotor (reluctor) set
note: The air gap is measured between the signal rotor's protrusion and the pick-up coil core (S-002 p.5-35).

name: Igniters, leading and trailing
note: On the distributor housing Aftermarket replacement Standard Motor Products LX-642 (obsolete) crosses to E30124910; Mazdatrix sells used, tested igniters at 135.00 USD. Trailing igniter B-20 (YG, BW), leading B-21 (YL, BW) per S-001; check on the car.

name: Distributor vacuum units
note: Two vacuum sets, 24 350 and 24 351. Vacuum tube 9935-10-4999 bulk (1800A-1 EC-056-20). With the Weber fitted, whether the vacuum units are still connected is unknown - confirm The trailing vacuum unit's position on its attaching screws sets trailing timing (S-002 p.5-36; S-006 p.44).

name: Distributor condenser
note: Radio-noise suppressor on the distributor Capacity 0.24-0.30 uF (S-038 T:3). Single BW lead (B-22) to the ignition feed, case to ground (S-001 Section B); check on the car.

name: Distributor contact
note: Catalogue figure 1820A-1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.57, printed 1-15) shows D-code 24496 as the small spring-loaded centre contact (carbon button) that sits in the centre of the distributor cap (24310) and bears on the rotor (24312); it is not a breaker point - the distributor is breakerless. 1985 FSM p.5-33 says to check the cap's centre contact for wear; no wear limit is given. Identification read from the drawing; check on the car.

name: Alternator stator
note: Three-phase star-wound stator, leads soldered to the rectifier (S-001 p.10 internal diagram; S-002 p.5-14).

name: Alternator rotor
note: Field-coil resistance differs by manual: 5-6 ohm (1980 FSM) vs 2.0-2.6 ohm (1985 FSM); no 1982 figure found, so measure across the slip rings before judging it.

name: Alternator front ball bearing
note: Mazda 9960-62-202 is a 6202-size ball bearing (15 x 35 x 11 mm); drive-end replacements 6202-2Z / 6202-2RS (RockAuto lists Schaeffler 62022Z, SKF 62022ZJ, National 202SS). Pressed into the front bracket under a retainer; pre-lubricated.

name: Alternator rear ball bearing
note: On the rotor shaft Slip-ring-end bearing; RockAuto's commutator-end fitment is 6201-2RS (12 x 32 x 10 mm), e.g. SKF 62012RSJ, National 201CC - check the size on the old bearing. A stopper spring sits in a groove on its outer race; the rear bracket must be heated to fit or remove it.

name: Alternator rectifier
note: Part number read as N221-24-?10 in the scan; N221-24-510 by its D-code 24 510 - check the digit before ordering An aftermarket listing (AS-PL ARC5017) cross-references Mazda N221-24-510 exactly, which supports the -510 reading. Six 25 A main diodes plus a diode trio, 80 mm mounting centres.

name: Alternator voltage regulator (internal)
note: Screw set 1757-24-526 Replacements crossing N221-24-520: SMP VR163, Wells 1V1083, Transpo-type IM204 (12 V, A-circuit, R-L terminals, 14.6 V set). Mitsubishi numbers MD607372 / MD607570.

name: Alternator brushes and springs
note: Brush 8173-24-522 x2, brush spring 8173-24-521 x2 SMP JX106 crosses 8173-24-522. Brushes are soldered by their pigtails; solder so the wear-limit line stands 2-3 mm out of the holder.

name: Alternator pulley
note: Pulley nut set 8028-24-533

name: Alternator front bracket (drive-end housing)
note: Carries the front bearing (under a retainer) and the rotor; separated from the stator by prying at its slots after the through bolts are out (S-045 5:2, S-002 p.5-12).

name: Alternator rear bracket (rear housing)
note: Holds the stator, rectifier, brush holder and IC regulator; the F test hole is here, about 20 mm deep near the B terminal. The rear bearing is a tight fit, so heat the bracket before removing or fitting the rotor.

name: Alternator terminal set
note: The B terminal is a stud with a nut and an insulating bushing through the rear bracket; the 1980 unit also has a radio-noise suppression condenser on B (S-045 5:2, S-002 p.5-13).

name: Starter magnetic switch (solenoid)
note: Listed without a description on the A/T line under 24 760 SWITCH SMP SS298 and Wells 1M1169 list interchange 887224736 (this part) and 175724760; both are 3-terminal (B, S, M) Mitsubishi-type switches. Washers between the switch and the front bracket set the pinion gap.

name: Starter yoke (field frame)
note: A/T line under 24 701 YOKE Yoke carries the series field coil: S-002 p.5-19 shows the solenoid M terminal feeding the field coil, which feeds the (+) brushes. Test: continuity connector-to-brush, none connector-to-yoke (S-002 p.5-26/5-27, 1985).

name: Starter armature
note: The A/T starter is the gear-reduction type (S-002 p.5-3, 5-19, 5-21; this car's catalogue lists a centre bracket and reduction gears). The armature runs in a ball bearing at each end.

name: Starter brush holder and brushes
note: Brush springs 0222-24-752A x4 4 brushes on the A/T starter (S-038 T:3), two (+) brushes fed from the field coil and two (-) brushes on the grounded plate. Brush wear limit 11.5 mm is SP-071 on PT026.

name: Starter front bracket (drive housing)
note: Front bracket bearing is not sold separately; it is replaced with the bracket (S-002 p.5-25, 5-28). Pinion-gap shims sit between the solenoid and this bracket.

name: Starter rear bracket (end cover)
note: Cover set N202-24-741; bolt set N202-24-731 Held by two through-bolts and two brush-holder screws; brush holder and rear bracket are symmetrical and fit either way round (S-002 p.5-23, 5-30).

name: Starter centre bracket
note: Held by one installation bolt; behind its cover sit a C washer and an adjusting washer that set the pinion-shaft thrust gap (S-002 p.5-24, 5-29).

name: Starter pinion and stopper set
note: Pinion is held by a stop ring in a groove in the pinion shaft; a scarred stop ring must never be reused (S-002 p.5-25, 5-29).

name: Starter overrunning clutch shaft
note: The overrunning clutch is part of the pinion shaft assembly and is replaced as one unit if it slips or binds (S-002 p.5-28).

name: Starter reduction gears
note: Gear set N202-24-744, gear N202-24-746, shaft N202-24-740 The armature-shaft gear drives the reduction gear on the pinion shaft; both are greased at assembly (S-002 p.5-29).

name: Starter drive lever
note: A/T line under 24 730 LEVER The lever is moved by the solenoid plunger and shifts the overrunning clutch and pinion. It must be fitted facing the correct way, and its sliding part is greased (S-002 p.5-19, 5-29).

name: Starter bearings
note: Ball bearings at both ends of the armature come off with an ordinary bearing puller and go on with a hand press (S-002 p.5-24, 5-28).

name: Battery carrier, tray and clamp
note: Clamp bolt 0613-65-857A Figure 1850A-1 (S-005 EC p.61) shows a bar clamp across the battery top held by a hooked J-rod (clamp bolt 70985A) and nut 999400602, with the tray (56863A) on the carrier (53260) that bolts to the body with 997960612. Clamp 8871-56-030A is retired by Mazda; Atkins Rotary lists it new at USD 52, out of stock on 2026-09-25.

name: Battery positive cable
note: A/T; cable clips 1011-67-291A, 1011-67-293 Per S-001 Section A the battery + post feeds the starting motor directly and, through the 1.25 sq main fusible link at X-07, the WR constant bus (ignition switch, alternator B). The A/T cable 8872-67-250B differs from the M/T one; aftermarket SMP cables are listed for 1979-85 RX-7 but none is confirmed to match the A/T routing.

name: Battery ground cable
note: S-001 shows the battery - post straight to ground; the ground point (body or engine) is not drawn, check on the car. Retail listing: Standard Motor Products A22-4, negative, 1979-1985 RX-7 (not checked against 8871-67-260A).

name: Oil level sensor
note: Feeds the oil level warning lamp Float switch in the oil pan, one wire (BG); it grounds that wire through its body when the float drops, lighting the 3.4 W OIL LEVEL lamp. N201-10-730 is discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix 2026-09); Atkins sells a block-off plate ARE8907 for the pan opening.

name: Coolant level sensor
note: Gasket 8553-15-611. Parent taken as the radiator (filler neck/top tank) - check where it sits Screws into the top of the radiator (M11.5x1.25, gasket 8553-15-611), which supports the parent taken. Single wire Br to the coolant level unit.

name: Coolant level warning unit
note: Drives the coolant level warning lamp from the sensor Delay unit: lights the COOLANT lamp 9-16 s after the sensor loses contact with coolant (1985 figure).

name: Temperature switch
note: Emission-control temperature switch; whether it still does anything with the Weber is unknown - confirm Catalogue figure 6600A-1 draws it on the front of the engine (water pump housing), which matches the No. 1 water temperature switch B-12 of the 1982 wiring diagram (LB to the emission control unit, LW to the hot start relay); check that identification on the car. 8341-18-880 is no longer available (Atkins, NLA).

name: Thermo switch (18 890)
note: Two thermo switches listed under 18 890: 8182-18-970A (first digit read from the S-005 index) and N201-18-890 (81-82). Where each sits and whether still wired with the Weber - confirm The 1982 wiring diagram shows three temperature switches on the emission control unit: No.1 water temp switch B-12 (engine, LB/LW, on below 70 C), No.2 water temp switch B-11 (radiator, LB/LY, on above 15 C) and the heat hazard sensor B-13 (floor, LB/RY, 130 C) (S-001 p12; S-006 p85, p93-94); which of them the two 18 890 thermo switches are is not stated - check on the car.

name: Emission control unit
note: '81-'82 A/T unit; control-unit bracket ?87?-18-820C. Largely served the factory carburettor; whether it is still connected with the Weber - confirm Senses throttle opening, radiator temperature, choke knob, floor temperature and engine speed (from the ignition coil primary), and drives the five three-way solenoids and the heat hazard lamp; its speed switch points are 1100 and 4000 rpm (S-006 p70, p85, p93).

name: Throttle sensor
note: Mounted on the factory carburettor; presumed gone with it (Weber 45 DCOE) - confirm. Bolts 1480-18-912? x2

name: Inhibitor switch (neutral safety and reverse lamp)
note: 8872-19-444B: the first digit, blank in the illustration list, is printed in the S-005 numeric index (group 6600A), consistent with the transmission 8872-19-090B. 4-pin connector A-06: BY/BW starter interlock (closed in P and N), GY/RW back-up lamps (closed in R). No new or aftermarket replacement found (Atkins lists none before 1986).

name: Downshift (kickdown) solenoid
note: Single BR wire (connector B-33), earthed through its body; fed from the kick-down switch under the accelerator via the 15 A fuse. Test: audible click on 12 V. No replacement listing found.

name: Horn relay
note: 1524-66-810B up to serial FB331..634422, FA01-66-810A from 634423; VIN serial unknown - check. Relay bracket FA03-66-820B Normally-open 3-wire relay: GW (15 A fuse, shared with stop lamps) feeds coil and contact, the horn button grounds the coil through GL, the contact sends GY to both horns (S-001 p22). The catalogue figure 6630A-1 and the 1985 manual (p15-11) put it under the dash LH beside the CPU, not in the engine bay as the horn write-up says - check.

name: Central processing unit (warning and flasher control unit)
note: FA03-67-560 without the illuminated key and warning lamp option, FA02-67-560 with it; which the car has - check. Case FA02-67-571, cover FA02-67-572, plate FA02-67-574, screws 8545-67-568 x10, bushings 0866-67-717 x3 One box doing the turn/hazard flasher, intermittent wiper relay, lights-on/key reminder chime oscillator, ignition key light timer, buzzer and seat belt timer (S-006 p24, S-001 sections D, F, H); 17-way connector X-16 plus a 1-way GB (S-001 p30). Known failure: cracked solder joints at the board connector, fixed by resoldering (rx7club).

name: Turn and hazard flasher relay
note: Plugs into the CPU unit. The catalogue gives no number for serials from FB331..503736 (all '82 cars); read it off the relay - check Atkins Rotary lists FA02-67-577 as fitting all 1981-85 RX-7s (out of stock, $199), while the catalogue gives it only to '81 serials up to 503735 and no number for later cars; read the number off the relay - check.

name: Lamp checker relay
note: Listed only for cars without the illuminated key and warning lamp option - check it is fitted Catalogue figure 6630A-1 (S-005 BI p.101) draws the LAMPC. relay (67660) on the relay bracket under the dash beside the C.P.U. and horn relay; this is most likely the F-03 stop light checker of S-001 p.22 (W in, G out to stop lamps, GL to the meter warning, B ground) - check. OEM-RECORD.md lists F-03 as Rear, which disagrees with the catalogue drawing - check on the car.

name: Oscillator unit
note: In the front of the car by the horns; function not stated on the figure - check The warning oscillator C-10: it takes the oil-level (YR) and coolant-level (YB) warning lines and drives the chime (G), fed via LR from the choke and check relay (S-001 p16). Sits on the left front fender near the battery; when it fails or gets damp the buzzer sounds and will not stop (Atkins Rotary).

name: Choke and check relay
note: Served the factory carburettor's electric choke; whether still fitted and wired with the Weber - confirm No cold-start hardware remains since the Weber conversion.

name: Power antenna relay
note: Whether the car has a power antenna - confirm Two change-over contact sets and a diode-protected coil (S-001 p24): at rest LR feeds R and LY is grounded (mast down); with the coil grounded through LG by the radio or antenna switch, LR feeds L and R is grounded (mast up). Read from a coarse scan and checked against the 1985 manual's motor test - check.

name: 3-point relay
note: Mazda Warehouse sells 1480-67-740 as the Hot Start Relay ('3 Point Relay'), and the catalogue figure puts it in the LH engine bay beside the choke & check relay, where the 1985 manual (p15-11) puts the 12A hot start relay: so this is most likely S-001's A-03 hot start relay - confirm on the car. No cold-start hardware remains since the Weber conversion.

name: Front harness
note: FA30-67-010D covers '82 serials FB331..600001-622565; no '82 number is listed for later serials. VIN serial unknown - check

name: Fuse block
note: Included in the front harness S-001 p30 (X-04) shows 15 fuses on four feeds: WR battery, L accessory, BY ignition and BW ignition. OEM-RECORD's bus map reads two positions differently: it shows a 7.5 A BW alternator fuse, where S-001 p10/p14 show BW coming off a 15 A fuse from BY (IG) to the alternator, coils and emission parts, and Br off a 10 A (IG) fuse to cruise control.

name: Fuse block cover
note: FA01-66-731B for a Furukawa-made block, FA01-66-732B for Yazaki; read the maker off the block - check

name: Fuses, 10 A
note: Fuse body style (glass cartridge or flat Japanese type) was not found in any source; read it off the block before buying - check.

name: Fusible links, brown
note: Catalogue rating (10M OHM), brown The two brown 0.3 sq links sit either side of the black main link in the battery-side block X-07. One feeds the headlight retractor (WR), the other the headlights (WG) (S-001 p30).

name: Fusible link, black
note: Catalogue rating (7M OHM), black The black 1.25 sq main link carries battery + to the WR constant bus that feeds the ignition switch and fuse block (S-001 p10, p30).

name: Rear harness
note: Joins the front harness at X-03, a 22-cavity (3+5+3 per row) connector, 21 wires, one unused (S-001 p30); per the routing sheet X-03 is on the left side behind the door (S-001 p15, check). S-001 shows the rear defroster feed (LG, p24) and the back-up lamp output (RW, p22) passing through it. Mazda no longer supplies it; only used harnesses are available.

name: Rear defogger cord
note: Feeds the rear defrost grid (PT037). Listed for cars without a rear wiper (BI-107-27, same number); whether the car has a rear wiper - check On a car without a rear wiper this is the defroster grid's ground return: grid G-25 terminal (B) to connector X-18 (two 1-pin connectors, B wire) to ground X-15. The feed (LG) comes through the rear harness at X-03 (S-001 p24, p30). With a rear wiper the grid ground passes through D-07 instead.

name: Rear wiper terminals
note: Only with a rear wiper; whether the car has one - confirm Used only with the rear wiper, at the connector to the rear wiper (D-07, wires B, LB, BG, L per S-001 section D). The grid ground shares that connector ('D-07 or X-18', S-001 p24). If the car has no rear wiper, these terminals are not fitted.

name: Engine harness
note: Lock washer 8872-18-056 (A/T) Joins the front harness at X-01, a 22-cavity connector with 20 wires (S-001 p30). Four wires change colour across it (front side / engine side): BLb/Lg, YR/BG, BR/Br, BrR/LgY. The 81-82 harness has a white tag with an FA01/FA02-style number (rx7club); Mazda no longer supplies it.

name: Engine harness fusible link
note: This is S-001's A-02: a 0.5 sq fusible link, printed green (G). A ring terminal sits on the starting motor's battery terminal, held by lock washer 8872-18-056 and a nut (S-005 fig 6701A-1). It feeds the LW wire through X-10 to the hot start relay (A-03) and the No.1 water temp switch (S-001 p10). The identification is by matching drawings; check on the car. With the Weber conversion the hot-start circuit may be dead.

name: Transmission harness
note: A/T The A/T transmission harness joins at X-10, a 6-pin connector (BW GY BR / LW RW BY), and at X-17, two 1-pin connectors (BL, BY) (S-001 p30). It carries the inhibitor switch's start interlock (BY in, BW out to the starter), the back-up lamp circuit (GY in, RW out) and the LW hot-start feed.

name: Short connector
note: A shorting plug in the engine harness; which circuit it bridges - check This is S-001's B-09 short connector, on top of the engine (S-001 p15). The plug joins wire GB (emission control unit terminal V, via X-01) to wire BY (the starter ST signal, which also reaches unit terminal H) (S-001 p12). What the unit does with that input is not stated in S-001; check.

name: Instrument harness
note: This is S-001's 'inpane' harness. It meets the front harness at X-02 (22 pins, all used) and X-12 (10-pin plus a 2-pin RL/GL), and meets the GSL parking brake harness at X-11 (S-001 p30). The 81-83 dash harness FA01-67-030C still turns up used; Mazda no longer supplies it.

name: Drive plate (flexplate) with adapter
note: bolted to the eccentric shaft; carries the torque converter. fasteners: EC-062-08 (converter bolts, 4) Mazda 1758-19-020B is still sold new as the 79-83 RX-7 automatic flex plate (Atkins Rotary). The drive plate goes on over the A/T counterweight, positioned so the hole in the drive plate lines up with the counterweight as the factory figure shows, and both are held by the eccentric-shaft lock nut (see the flywheel/counterweight lock nut torque); mark plate and converter before separating them.

name: Torque converter
note: Mark converter and drive plate before removal and refit on the marks (S-045 7A:18).

name: Transmission oil pump
note: gasket 8U01-21-253 (EC-062-13); fasteners: EC-062-14 Gear-and-crescent pump; inner and outer gears are replaced as a set; mark the gears' top faces before removal (S-045 7A:10).

name: Front pump oil seal (converter seal)
note: the usual front leak point Aftermarket 3N71B front pump seal 42 x 60 x 9 mm (metal clad) sold under the Nissan name; check against the removed seal.

name: Oil pump cover
note: check balls 0338-19-245A (2) and spring 0338-19-247 inside; fasteners: EC-062-20

name: Oil pump cover seal rings
note: 2 x 8U01-19-256, 8U01-19-257 (qty not legible in catalogue), 1 cut-ring seal 0338-19-258 Catalogue OCR reads the 8U01-19-257 quantity as 1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.62); check.

name: Vacuum diaphragm pipe and hose
note: engine vacuum to the modulator; part of the vacuum lines (PT012). clip: EC-062-27 ATF found inside the vacuum pipe means the vacuum diaphragm has failed (S-002 7B-16).

name: ATF cooler pipes
note: '81-'82 parts; run to the cooler in the radiator. banjo bolts 9938-10-800 (EC-062-32); oil pipe spacer 2850-13-331 (EC-062-01)

name: ATF cooler hoses
note: qty 2, '81-'82 part; age-hardened rubber is a leak risk. clips: EC-062-36, EC-062-37

name: Transmission case
note: '81-'82 part; square-head plugs 0338-19-331A (2, pressure test ports) The line-pressure test port is at the right rear of the case (S-045 7A:18).

name: Extension housing rear oil seal
note: seals the propeller shaft yoke; common leak point Genuine 0437-17-335A still sold (Mazdatrix $11.63, 71-85 auto and manual); aftermarket Mazda-size 3N71B extension seal 35 x 48 x 15 mm.

name: Band anchor-end bolt (band adjuster)
note: the external band adjustment; lock washer 0338-19-388A and nut 0338-19-389 (check these two belong to the anchor bolt, not the servo stem) The washer 0338-19-388A and nut 0338-19-389 sit between the piston stem 19386 and the servo retainer in the catalogue list (S-005 p.64), and the band is adjusted at the servo piston stem with its lock nut (S-038 T:7, S-045 7A:17), so they belong to the stem; the anchor-end bolt is the fixed band anchor, not the adjuster.

name: Band servo
note: piston 0842-19-381, stem 1758-19-386, return spring 0338-19-363, retainer 1758-19-391A, cover 1758-19-392A. fasteners: EC-064-23, EC-064-24 Piston comes out with compressed air into the oil passage (S-045 7A:9). Adjustment is at the stem: 12-15 Nm, back off two turns, lock nut 15-40 Nm.

name: Band servo seals
note: piston seals, leather-cut seal and two O-rings

name: Speedometer driven gear
note: catalogue remark FB331 ..500076- (transmission serial split); check the transmission serial on its plate is 500076 or later, else the earlier gear is fitted '81 model up to transmission serial FB331-500075 used 8562-17-441A; 8057-17-441C from 500076 (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.64).

name: Speedometer driven gear sleeve
note: O-ring 1011-17-443 (EC-064-28) Genuine 1011-17-442A still sold by Atkins Rotary ($28, in stock 2026-09).

name: Extension housing
note: fasteners: EC-064-32, EC-064-33 8 bolts 0338-19-737 with plain washers 0338-19-739 (S-005 fig 1920A-1); the rear oil seal 0437-17-335A and the speedometer driven gear sleeve sit in it. Removal of the propeller shaft: fit turning holder 49 0259 440 in the housing so fluid does not run out (S-045 7A:1).

name: Extension housing gasket
note: Discard and renew whenever the housing comes off; the Cobra 53002F 3N71B overhaul kit (S-201) supplies the gaskets and seals.

name: Control valve body
note: fasteners: EC-065-05, EC-065-06, EC-065-07 Nine attaching bolts in three lengths: 4x 0338-19-831, 2x 0338-19-832, 3x 0338-19-833 (S-005 fig 1920A-2); keep them sorted by length at removal (S-002 7B-32). Upper body, separator plate and lower body; the lower body carries the throttle relief ball and the orifice check valve with their springs (S-045 7A:12).

name: Manual valve
note: Slides off the valve body; on installation the pin on the manual plate must sit in its groove (S-045 7A:12, 7A:17).

name: Transmission oil strainer (filter)
note: service item at a fluid change; O-rings 0338-19-822 (2) Aftermarket filter kits cross to 1758-19-815: Raybestos 357418 (filter 515418 + nitrile gasket 22G418, L3N71B with external servo 1974-83) and ATP B-416 (1979-83 RX-7). Bolted to the underside of the control valve body.

name: Vacuum diaphragm (modulator)
note: sets shift points from engine vacuum; a ruptured diaphragm draws ATF into the engine BT07-19-823 is the current Mazda number and supersedes 0338-19-823 and 1758-19-823; still sold new by Atkins Rotary and Mazdatrix. Its vacuum sensing tube runs to the carburettor base (S-045 7A:1; rx7club). Takes the selective rod PT355; do not leave the rod stuck in the diaphragm tip at removal (S-002 7B-32).

name: Vacuum diaphragm rod (selective length)
note: lengths 29.0/29.5/30.0/30.5/31.0 mm; FT01-19-824 is an alternative number listed after the 29.0 rod. check the fitted length by measuring when the diaphragm is out Selected from the measured depth of the vacuum throttle valve bore after any change of control valve body or case (S-045 7A:17, S-002 7B-78).

name: Oil pan gasket
note: renew at every pan drop Mazda has discontinued 1758-19-835; Atkins Rotary still stocks and can make it. A parts.mazdausa.com search listing shows 0338-19-835B as the current genuine number (check). Raybestos 22G418 (in kit 357418) and ATP B-416 are the aftermarket gaskets.

name: Transmission oil pan
note: fasteners: EC-065-10 (17 bolts) 17 bolts 0338-19-837 (S-005 fig 1920A-2, page 1-D6); the ATP B-416 gasket is described as 14 bolt holes, check against the pan. Inspect what is in the pan at removal: dark or burnt fluid or friction particles point to the clutches or band, a tacky varnish film to sticking valves (S-002 7B-32).

name: ATF filler/level tube
note: O-ring 9954-10-1601; clips: EC-065-14 Fluid is added through this tube; O-ring 9954-10-1601 at the case and two clips 3876-19-916 (S-005 fig 1920A-2).

name: ATF dipstick
note: Marked L and F; level is read hot, engine idling, selector in P after passing through every range (S-045 7A:18, S-002 0-24).

name: Brake band (kickdown band)
note: band strut 0338-19-361B (EC-064-10) Holds the front clutch drum for 2nd gear (D2, 2 and 1-2nd); the servo piston stem sets its adjustment (S-002 7B-8). Removed with its strut after backing off the piston stem (S-045 7A:4).

name: Front clutch
note: Applied in 3rd and reverse (S-002 7B-8). Contains 3 drive and 3 driven plates (S-002 7B-2), a dished plate, the piston with two seals, 10 return springs, retainer and the selective retaining plate PT369.

name: Front clutch drum
note: 3959- prefix is the '81-83 drum; the 1980 manual's front clutch took 7.2-8.2 mm retaining plates where this one takes 5.0-6.2 mm, so 1980 figures for the front clutch do not transfer (S-045 7A:7 vs S-005 fig 1930A-1).

name: Clutch pistons (front and rear)
note: qty 2, one in each clutch; shared by the front and rear clutch, so listed under the transmission Removed by compressed air into the clutch oil passage; fitted with even pressure round its rim so the seals are not cut (S-045 7A:7, S-002 7B-43).

name: Clutch piston seals
note: O-rings and leather-cut seals, 2 each Outer seal and inner seal per piston (S-045 fig 7A-23); never reused. The Cobra 53002F overhaul kit (S-201) supplies lip seals and O-rings.

name: Clutch piston return springs
note: 20 springs, 2 retainers, both clutches; snap rings 0338-19-488 (2); shared by the front and rear clutch, so listed under the transmission 10 springs and one retainer per clutch; compressed with tool 49 0378 375 to release the snap ring (S-002 7B-42, 7B-53).

name: Clutch dished plates
note: qty 2; BU17-19-498 is the alternative number; shared by the front and rear clutch, so listed under the transmission One per clutch, first plate against the piston; direction is shown in the manual figure and matters (S-002 7B-43, 7B-54).

name: Clutch driven plates (steels)
note: qty 7 across both clutches; shared by the front and rear clutch, so listed under the transmission 3 in the front clutch, 4 in the rear (S-002 7B-2). The Raybestos steel module STMMAZDA01 (S-202) lists 6 direct/forward steels, one short of the catalogue's 7: check before ordering.

name: Clutch drive plates (frictions)
note: qty 7 across both clutches; shared by the front and rear clutch, so listed under the transmission 3 in the front clutch, 4 in the rear (S-002 7B-2). Raybestos R560161 (1981-on forward/direct friction, S-202) is the aftermarket plate.

name: Front clutch retaining plate (selective)
note: thickness 5.0-6.2 mm in 0.2 steps sets clutch clearance; check fitted thickness at teardown. snap rings 0338-19-509 (2) Sets the front clutch clearance; the 1985 manual lists the same 5.0-6.2 mm range for its front clutch (S-002 7B-53).

name: Rear clutch
note: Applied in every forward range (D1, D2, D3, 2, 1); 4 drive and 4 driven plates (S-002 7B-2, 7B-8). Its retaining plate is not selective: an off-standard clearance means new plates (S-045 7A:8).

name: Rear clutch drum
note: Comes out with the front clutch, rear clutch hub, front carrier, connecting shell and sun gear as one assembly (S-045 7A:4).

name: Rear clutch retaining plate
note: One thickness only (single catalogue number); clearance is corrected with plates, not this part (S-005 fig 1930A-1, S-045 7A:8).

name: Rear clutch hubs
note: snap ring 0338-19-534 Two hub numbers 0338-19-530 and -531 retained by snap ring 0338-19-534 (S-005 fig 1930A-1); fitted with the front planetary carrier on top of the rear clutch (S-002 7B-70).

name: Front planetary carrier
note: Replaced as a unit if the pinion washer clearance is over the limit (S-045 7A:14).

name: Sun gear and connecting shell
note: race 0338-19-566, snap ring 0338-19-567 Shell alone is 0338-19-565 (S-005 fig 1930A-1). Total end play is read by moving the connecting shell fore and aft with a screwdriver behind it, dial indicator on the input shaft; front clutch drum end play is the feeler gap between the front clutch drum and this shell (S-045 7A:16).

name: Sun gear
note: Directional: the grooved face goes to the front, where the carrier washer bears on it (S-002 7B-55).

name: Rear planetary carrier
note: snap ring 0338-19-598

name: Thrust needle bearings and races
note: 7 needle bearings, 4 races The 1985 workshop manual (S-002 p.7B-79, L4N71B) draws where every thrust needle bearing and race sits in the case; the 3N71B positions behind the overdrive section are the same layout.

name: Pump cover thrust race (selective, end play)
note: thickness 1.2-2.2 mm sets total end play; check fitted thickness at teardown Six selective races, 1.2-2.2 mm in 0.2 mm steps; total end play is read with a dial indicator on the input shaft while the connecting shell is levered fore and aft.

name: Front clutch thrust washer (selective)
note: thickness 1.3-2.7 mm sets front end play; check fitted thickness at teardown Front clutch drum end play is measured with a feeler gauge between the front clutch drum and the connecting shell; the catalogue lists eight washers (1.3-2.7 mm) while the 1980 manual lists seven (1.5-2.7 mm).

name: Transmission overhaul repair kit
note: '81-'82 kit (catalogue: repair kit, clutch) Aftermarket 3N71B overhaul (soft parts) kits listing the 1979-85 RX-7 are available, e.g. Cobra 53002F.

name: Speedometer drive gear
note: located by steel ball 9961-11-500

name: Output flange and drive flange
note: snap ring 0338-19-534

name: Connecting drum (low and reverse)
note: The 1985 workshop manual (S-002 p.7B-56) has an exploded view of the connecting drum, rear planetary carrier and one-way clutch with the removal order.

name: Low one-way clutch
note: snap rings 0338-19-596 (2) Fit with the arrow mark toward the front of the car; it must turn freely in one direction only (clockwise, 1980 manual).

name: One-way clutch outer race
note: snap ring 0338-19-594

name: One-way clutch inner race
note: bolted to the case rear. fasteners: EC-064-06, EC-064-07, EC-068-03 Its eight bolts are reached from the case side with Mazda hex socket 49 0378 346.

name: Low and reverse brake
note: multi-plate brake in the case (no single catalogue number; its parts are the rows below); snap ring 0338-19-619 (EC-068-28)

name: Low and reverse piston return spring
note: thrust spring ring 0338-19-605; snap ring 0338-19-607

name: Low and reverse driven plates (steels)
note: qty 4

name: Low and reverse drive plates (frictions)
note: qty 4

name: Low and reverse retaining plate (selective)
note: thickness 7.8-8.8 mm sets brake clearance; check fitted thickness at teardown Six selective plates, 7.8-8.8 mm in 0.2 mm steps; clearance to the snap ring is checked with a feeler gauge.

name: Oil distributor
note: bearing race 0436-19-656 (2)

name: Oil distributor seal rings
note: qty 3

name: Governor
note: retainer plates 0338-19-667 (3)

name: Governor valves and springs
note: two valves, each with its spring The secondary governor spring is the stronger of the two and must not be swapped with the primary; the valves should slide in their bores under their own weight when dry.

name: Transmission select lever (on the case)
note: the shift linkage rod joins here; washer 1758-19-055

name: Manual (detent) plate
note: Sits inside the case on the manual shaft; its pin drives the manual valve in the control valve body and its detent notches give the selector positions (N is the third detent from the rear, per the 1980 manual).

name: Parking rod
note: sleeve 1758-19-455A Runs from the manual plate back into the extension housing, where its rear end rides between the two spring-loaded steel balls of the actuator support; it is unhooked by removing a snap ring at the parking lever.

name: Parking actuator support
note: retaining plate 0338-19-702A; ball-park springs 0338-19-703 (2), retainer 0338-19-704, steel balls 9961-12-750 (2). fasteners: EC-069-19 Bolted inside the extension housing; its two steel balls press the parking rod against the pawl in P.

name: Parking pawl
note: pawl shaft 0338-19-731, dowel spacer 0338-19-734A. fasteners: EC-069-24, EC-069-25 Mounted in the extension housing on its pawl shaft; the factory inspection is a visual check for wear or damage, with no dimension given.

name: Shift lever (automatic selector)
note: washer 1481-46-019 Linkage is adjusted at the T-joint under the car with both the lever and the transmission range lever in N (1980 7A-G-1); used 81-85 A/T selector assemblies with knob turn up on eBay, no new part found.

name: Selector lever push rod
note: '81-'82 part; guide pin 8174-46-022 Its travel is set by how far the knob is screwed onto the lever (1980 7A-G-2): fully in, then out one turn so the button faces the driver.

name: Shift knob
note: '81-'82 part; 00 is black Screws onto the lever with a lock nut; setting the knob one turn out from fully in (button toward the driver) is what makes the P and N-R/D-2 interlock work (1980 7A-G-2). Not stocked new by Atkins (their knob list has no 79-85 automatic knob); used only.

name: Shift knob push button
note: '81-'82 part; pin 1244-46-035, spring 1244-46-038 Must be pressed for P and for N to R and D to 2; if those moves work without the button, the knob is screwed too far in (1980 7A-G-2).

name: Selector lever detent lever
note: '81-'82 part; catalogue says only LEVER (46 055); nut 8202-46-061A, spring 2375-46-062

name: Shift adjusting lever
note: where the linkage is adjusted to the detents The adjustment point is the T-joint at the lower end of the selector lever operating arm: with the transmission range lever in N (third detent from the rear) the T-joint is set so it enters the arm's hole freely, then the nuts are tightened (1980 7A-G-1).

name: Shift linkage rod
note: joins the adjusting lever to the lever on the case The manual-linkage adjustment is made with the selector in N: the T-joint nuts on the rod are set so the joint enters the hole of the lever on the case freely; check whether FA03-46-571 is the rod that carries that T-joint.

name: Shift linkage bushings
note: bushing, counter-lever bushing, joint bushing; worn bushings give a sloppy selector

name: Propeller shaft
note: fasteners: rear flange bolts 1393-25-123 x4 (EC-084-14) Factory shaft 8871-25-100 discontinued (Mazdatrix 25-1000-8871 NLA); Mazdatrix sells an aftermarket 79-82 shaft 2691-700 (manual and automatic) with a factory-size rear joint and a Dodge 7260 front joint. Mark the shaft and the axle companion flange before removal to keep the balance; fit main shaft turning holder 49 0259 440 in the extension housing after removal (1985 FSM 8-3).

name: Propeller shaft universal joint set
note: retaining snap rings are selective thickness 1.22-1.38 mm: 0259-25-071B, -072B, -073B, -074B, -075B, -076B, -077A (or -077B), -078B, -079B; measure to choose 1979-82 shafts carry snap-ring joints, so the joints are serviceable; 1983-85 shafts are staked (rx7club). Aftermarket joints listed for this car: Moog 397, SKF UJ397, GMB / FVP 220-0007 (greasable), Dana Spicer 5-3229X; check the cap size against the 25 mm spider before buying.

name: Propeller shaft front yoke (universal joint yoke)
Propeller shaft yoke
note: Mazdatrix lists a 79-82 rear driveshaft flange 1502-29 (manual or automatic, joint not included); check it is this yoke.

name: Rear axle casing
note: S and GS casing (GSL disc casing does not apply) Casing is the 1979-83 small-bearing type; the 1984-85 casing is bored for the larger bearing and does not swap (rx7club interchange thread).

name: Rear axle breather
note: A clogged breather shows as oil leakage at the axle (1985 FSM 9-3).

name: Rear axle shafts
note: Pulled with rear axle shaft puller 49 0223 630B and attachment 49 8501 631 after the drum, shoes, backing plate nuts and brake pipe are off (1985 FSM 9-7). The wheel bearing that rides on it is sold by Atkins as 8871-26-151A (71-83 12A); Timken/National RW102R is the cross-reference given on rx7club for 1979-83.

name: Rear axle bearing collars
note: pressed on behind the bearing; renewed whenever the bearing is Removed by grinding one side down to 0.5 mm and breaking it with a chisel; pressed on dry (no oil or grease) with bearing separator attachment 49 1011 748 (1985 FSM 9-8, 9-9). Atkins sells it as 8531-26-152, 71-83 12A.

name: Rear axle shaft oil seals
note: Fitted with main drive gear installer 49 0180 321A, lip greased (1985 FSM 9-10); leave it in place unless it is being renewed. Atkins 0187-26-154, 79-83; National/Timken 1214N is the rx7club cross-reference for 1979-83.

name: Differential carrier
note: To drop the carrier, leave two nuts on loosely and tap the carrier with a wooden hammer; refit with sealant 8527 77 739 on the joint, then bleed the brakes and refill (1985 FSM 9-11, 9-12). Mounts on engine stand 49 0107 680A with attachments 49 0419 561 and 49 0223 561A, or carrier hanger 49 M005 667.

name: Differential companion flange
note: check: catalogue prints "'81 & '83", likely a misprint for '82; check the flange is the one on the car. fasteners: pinion lock nut 0223-27-030 (EC-089-06), washer 0223-27-012 (EC-089-01) Held with coupling flange holder 49 0259 710A to undo the nut, pulled with bearing puller set 49 0839 425C (1985 FSM 9-13, 9-14). Atkins stocks the lock nut 0223-27-030 and washer 0223-27-012; it lists the driveline bolt as 1456-25-123 with nut 1456-25-125 for 81-85 where the catalogue gives 1393-25-123 - check which the car has.

name: Differential pinion oil seal
note: '81-'82 No longer available from Mazda; Atkins sells an aftermarket seal under 0223-27-018 (79-82; 83-85 changed to M005-27-165 with the big flange). National/Timken 710326 is the rx7club cross-reference for 1979-86. Measure the seal drag with a torque wrench before the pinion nut is tightened, and subtract it from the preload reading (1985 FSM 9-19).

name: Final drive gear set (ring gear and drive pinion)
note: ratio 3.909 per catalogue; check the tag or count teeth. Setup parts: pinion bearing distance piece 0305-27-171; selective pinion spacers 3.08-3.47 mm 0223-27-401A to -415A; ring gear reamer bolts 8051-27-235 (D10.0) or 8051-27-236 (D10.2) x10 Ring gear and pinion are replaced only as a set (1985 FSM 9-16); Mazdatrix sells a new Mazda 3.909 short-nose set M037-27-110B for 74-85 non-turbo axles. Pinion height is set by the selective spacer: average the two side-bearing bore readings from the pinion model gauge and subtract the number electric-pencilled on the pinion end divided by 100; spacers step 0.03 mm (1985 FSM 9-17 to 9-19). Contact pattern is read with red lead: toe/flank contact means a thinner spacer, heel/face a thicker one (9-25).

name: Drive pinion front bearing
note: Atkins sells the front pinion bearing 0755-27-210 (79-85 front; 86-91 middle), replacing 0755-27-141 and 8051-27-142.

name: Drive pinion rear bearing
note: Atkins sells the rear pinion bearing 0221-27-210 with race (72-85 rotary cars), replacing 0221-27-141. Pressed onto the pinion over the selected height spacer (1985 FSM 9-19).

name: Differential case
note: S and GS open differential Open case, 12A S and GS; the LSD case is the two-piece clutch type and its parts are different. Side bearings are pressed on with a pipe of 41 mm bore or more and 47 mm outside or less, until the press force rises sharply (1985 FSM 9-21).

name: Differential side gears
note: thrust washers selective 2.00-2.20 mm: 0290-27-252, -256, -253, -259, -254 Backlash to the pinion gears is set by the selective thrust washer behind each side gear; washer marks 0, 05, 1, 15, 2 are 2.00 to 2.20 mm in 0.05 steps (1985 FSM 9-20).

name: Differential pinion gears
note: Inserted through the case windows 180 degrees apart and rotated 90 degrees to line up with the pinion shaft holes (1985 FSM 9-20).

name: Differential pinion shaft
note: retaining pin 0114-27-262 Lock (knock) pin is driven out with a drift and staked with a punch after refitting (1985 FSM 9-14, 9-21).

name: Differential side bearings
note: preload set by adjust screws 0290-27-301 x2 with lock plates 0290-27-302 x2 Atkins sells the side carrier bearing 0221-27-350 (79-91 non-turbo), replacing 0221-27-305, 0221-27-305A and G0A0-27-350; two per car. Pulled with bearing puller set 49 0839 425C; keep each outer race with its own bearing; adjusters turn with differential wrench 49 0259 720 (1985 FSM 9-13, 9-14, 9-24).

name: Rear brake backing plates
note: fasteners: bolts 3728-26-132 x8 (EC-087-01); plugs 0710-26-288 x2, 3648-26-288 x2 Carries the two shoe-adjusting hole plugs and the arrow that marks the star-wheel direction (S-002 11-10..11). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.87 (2610A-1).

name: Rear brake shoe upper return springs
note: Raybestos H17275 and Centric 118.45003 appear in search-result titles as rear drum hardware kits for the 81-85 RX-7; neither listing could be opened (Vivid Racing 403, RockAuto does not render), so fitment and contents are unverified: check that a kit includes this part before buying.

name: Rear brake shoe lower return springs
note: Raybestos H17275 and Centric 118.45003 appear in search-result titles as rear drum hardware kits for the 81-85 RX-7; neither listing could be opened (Vivid Racing 403, RockAuto does not render), so fitment and contents are unverified: check that a kit includes this part before buying.

name: Rear brake back springs
note: GA02-26-315: the digit blank in the illustration list is printed in the S-005 numeric index (group 2610A) and matches its D-code 26 315

name: Rear brake shoe hold-down springs
note: Genuine FA01-26-345 is listed on Amazon (page did not load; price unknown); the 1985 manual calls it the shoe retaining spring, removed with its guide pin (S-002 11-9).

name: Rear brake shoe hold-down pins
note: Genuine FA01-26-391 hold-down pins are listed on eBay (page did not load; price unknown).

name: Rear wheel cylinder boot sets
note: Item 13 'Cup & Boot set' in the 1985 rear drum structural view (S-002 11-8); no listing found.

name: Rear wheel cylinder bleeder screws
note: cap 0259-33-693 Mazdatrix stocks the 79-85 rear drum bleeder 0259-33-691 at 6.58 USD.

name: Rear brake self-adjusters
note: FA01-26-630 (R) and FA01-26-640 (L) are discontinued by Mazda: NLA at Atkins Rotary (75 USD when stocked) and at Mazdatrix. Adjust through hole A in the backing plate: turn the star wheel in the arrow direction until the wheel locks, then back off 3-4 notches (S-002 11-10..11).

name: Rear brake adjuster pawl levers
note: Pushed clear through hole B in the backing plate while the star wheel is backed off (S-002 11-11).

name: Rear parking brake operating levers
note: pivot pins FA01-26-832 (R), GA02-26-832 (L) The parking brake cable hooks straight onto this lever (S-002 11-9). Atkins Rotary has the right-hand lever FA01-26-810 at 25 USD, 'no longer available but quite a few left'.

name: Rear coil spring upper rubber seats
note: check: -013B up to serial FB331 700131, -013C from 700132; read the VIN serial Current service part 8871-28-013C (Atkins 23.50 USD, in stock) replaces 8871-28-013, -013A and -013B.

name: Rear shock absorbers (damper set)
note: the shock half of PT057. fasteners: lower mount bolts 1243-28-111 x2 (EC-091-05) Catalogue damper set FA01-99-281A (S-005 2800A-1). Mazdatrix sells OEM FA24-28-700 (144.97 USD) and KYB 343140 (54.65 USD); Atkins sells KYB 343140 as its 8871-99-281 replacement (65 USD).

name: Rear shock upper mount bushings
note: retainers 0223-28-776 x4, grommets 0259-28-778 x2 Bushing 8871-28-775 x4 (S-005 2800A-1); retainer 0223-28-776 still sold (Atkins 5.25 USD).

name: Rear upper links
note: catalogue calls it LINK; drawn as the upper trailing link. Pivot bolts 0305-28-111B (EC-091-04), shared with the lower links, 8 in all Catalogue LINK 8871-28-200 x2 (S-005 2800A-1). Energy Suspension 11.3104G (94 USD) re-bushes all four upper and lower links.

name: Rear lower links
note: pivot bolts 0305-28-111B, 8 in all across upper and lower links Lower link 8871-28-300A still sold new (Atkins 187 USD, in stock).

name: Watt link arms
note: run from the centre bracket on the differential out to the body Catalogue R 8871-28-160, L 8871-28-170 (S-005 2800A-1). Energy Suspension urethane Watt link bushing kit 11.7102G (40.36 USD at Atkins) re-bushes both links; each link goes in with its painted mark to the front and outside (S-002 13-15).

name: Watt link centre bracket
note: bolted to the differential carrier; the Watt link arms pivot on it. Washer 0866-34-158 (EC-091-16) Genuine Mazda 8871-28-180 still sold new (Atkins, 139 USD, in stock); the seller notes it bends when the car hits a kerb and pairs it with link nuts B037-28-091.

name: Rear stabilizer bar, 18 mm
note: '81-'82 18 mm bar The 1985 manual treats the rear bar as optional ('if equipped', S-002 13-16); the 1981-83 catalogue lists one 18 mm bar 8871-28-151A for '81 and '82 models.

name: Rear stabilizer bar mount bushings
note: for the 18 mm bar The catalogue gives 8871-28-156 for the 18 mm bar (S-005 2810A-1) but Mazdatrix lists 8871-28-156 as 17 mm and discontinued; measure the bar before ordering bushings.

name: Rear stabilizer control link brackets
note: check: fitted from serial FB331 510973 (Oct 1980); a 1982 car should be later, read the VIN serial Catalogue FA01-28-120B from serial FB331 510973 (S-005 2810A-1).

name: Rear stabilizer support brackets
note: check: fitted from serial FB331 501693; a 1982 car should be later, read the VIN serial

name: Rear stabilizer control link bushings
note: retainers 0710-28-776 x8; spacers 8871-28-157 x2 Bushing 0710-28-775 is still sold (Atkins 4.50 USD, Mazdatrix 5.15 USD; eight per car); Energy Suspension end-link set 9.8123 is the urethane alternative.

name: Steering wheel, 4-spoke
note: Standard wheel is urethane 8180-32-980B; a leather wheel 8344-32-980B (00) was a GS option - check which is on the car. Fasteners: set-screw 8871-32-740B (EC-093-08); cup set 8871-32-984 (EC-093-23) Nut 40-50 N·m (S-038 T:7). Mark wheel and shaft before removal and pull with a puller; never hammer the column shaft end, it is collapsible and the blow damages the bearing (S-002 p.10A-5, 1985). Only used wheels are on the market (eBay). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.93 (3200A-1).

name: Horn cap (horn pad)
note: The pad levers off the wheel (protect the spokes) and covers the horn contact set 8871-32-750 (S-005 EC-093, 4-spoke); the contact grounds the GL relay-coil wire through the column, so the wheel nut wrench sounds the horns unless the battery or the horn/stop 15 A fuse is out. Used only (eBay).

name: Horn contact set
note: The sliding horn contact in the wheel hub Carries the horn relay coil ground (GL via column connector E-01) to the steering shaft; the relay does the horn current, so the contact only carries coil current (S-001 p22). Horn ground runs through the column shaft and a strap across the collapsible joint (rx7club).

name: Steering gear housing
note: Atkins Rotary listed FA24-32-120 at 350 USD for 82-83 and 84-85 without power steering; NLA, out of stock. Housing-to-frame bolts 44-53 N·m with the alignment shim kept in place.

name: Steering worm and ball nut
note: Serviced only as a unit: the 1985 manual says do not disassemble the worm shaft and ball nut, and to replace the whole gear if the nut does not run freely on the worm (S-002 p.10A-7).

name: Steering sector shaft
note: The pre-1983 non-hardened shaft; adjusting shims 0208-32-188 x2 (EC-094-21) No longer sold separately (about 200 USD when it was; jimrothe.com); an rx7club owner with two 1982 cars reports the sector shafts differ within the year at the tapered-roller bearing seat (early: removable bearing set, later: a lip). Bush clearance wear limit 0.1 mm; adjusting-screw end clearance 0-0.1 mm (S-038 T:6).

name: Steering gear adjusting shim kit
note: Worm bearing preload shims

name: Steering gear end cover kit
note: Lock nut 230-260 N·m (S-038 T:8); the end cover screws in to set worm bearing preload before the lock nut is tightened.

name: Steering gear side cover kit
note: Carries the sector shaft adjusting screw Side cover bolts 45-55 N·m with sealing agent (S-002 p.10A-8, 1985). The flathead adjusting screw is the weak part: hand-tight only, over-tightening stops return-to-centre (rx7club).

name: Steering gear fixing bracket
note: FA24-32-420 (S-005 numeric index, group 3210A): FA01-32-420 to serial FB331 525551, FA24-32-420 after it; the car is serial 652095 (vehicle.vin), so FA24-32-420

name: Pitman arm
note: NLA from Mazda (Atkins Rotary); Atkins Rotary sells a rebuilt arm at 199.95 USD, out of stock. Nut 150-180 N·m on matched serrations; pulled with SST 49 0223 695E.

name: Steering column dust cover
note: Bushing 8871-32-412 (EC-094-25) with it

name: Steering center link
note: No new or reproduction centre link listed by Atkins Rotary or Mazdatrix. Joint nuts: pitman arm 30-45, idler arm 25-35, tie-rods 30-45 N·m, new split pins (S-038 T:7). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.95 (3230A-1).

name: Steering idler arm
note: Recall campaign 17510 covers the idler arm in some states - check whether done. Washer 0866-32-341 (EC-095-09) Recall campaign 17510 (1986-02-01) replaced the idler arm free on '79-'83 RX-7s in the road-salt states because the pin corrodes and seizes; a modified arm went into production from March 1983 - check for a replacement arm on the car. New arms: OEM 8871-32-320A NLA (Atkins 475 USD), Atkins aftermarket 99 USD NLA, Moog K9369 listed but reported unavailable; the usual repair is new bushes (PT490). Bracket bolts 44-55 N·m; revolving torque 20-60 N at 135 mm.

name: Idler arm bushings
note: Atkins Rotary 10.75 USD each, in stock, two per car (replaces 0866-32-329C, 1524-32-329A); Mazdatrix 12.14 USD. Worn bushes show as up-and-down play and a clunk; pack with lithium NLGI No. 2 on assembly.

name: Tie rods
note: The adjuster stud between the two ball joints, M14x1.5 x 113.5 mm (Atkins Rotary, 19.95 USD, in stock; Mazdatrix 22.37 USD); jam nuts 9992-21-400 (inside) and 9994-41-400 (outside), lock nuts 70-80 N·m. Toe-in is reset by turning the studs equally.

name: Tie rod ball joint sets
note: Which joints this set and the ?021-99-324 set are (outer vs inner) is read from the figure - check on the drawing before ordering Atkins Rotary's inner tie rod end 8531-32-240A 'replaces 8531-99-322A', so this set is the INNER joint (centre-link end) and 8021-99-324 (PT493) the outer - check against the figure. Atkins 95 USD in stock, Mazdatrix 84.28 USD; Moog ES2192R.

name: Steering linkage ball joint sets
note: The S-005 numeric index prints B021-99-324 (group 3230A); B and 8 are not told apart in the scan, and 8021- matches the dust seals 8021-32-279 - confirm with a dealer lookup before ordering Atkins Rotary sells the outer (knuckle-arm) tie rod end as 8021-32-280, 59.25 USD, aftermarket to OEM spec since Mazda discontinued it; the 8021- prefix supports reading the index's B021-99-324 as 8021-99-324 and places this set at the knuckle arm. Moog ES2355. Sealed, no lubrication service.

name: Steering linkage ball joint dust seals
note: 8021-32-279 x4 and one 8531-32-279 (the digit blank in the illustration list is printed in the S-005 numeric index, group 3230A) Atkins Rotary lists the 8021-32-279 boot for 79-91 at 15.95 USD, out of stock. Fitted with installer 49 8038 785 after packing with lithium NLGI No. 2 grease (S-002 p.10A-12).

name: Front hub grease caps
note: Catalogue 'cap, hub' 0419-33-071, qty 2 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97); 'grease cap' in the 1985 manual, first off when the hub comes apart (S-002 p.9-5). No listing found (one search).

name: Front caliper mounting adapters
note: 'Mounting adapter' in the 1985 structural view, item 11, bolted to the knuckle; the caliper support and pad clips hang on it (S-002 p.11-4). No listing found.

name: Front caliper pistons
note: Two versions listed; the <A> piece is the alternative - check which is fitted before ordering Removed by blowing compressed air into the fluid hole against a wood block; scoring or rust means a new piston or caliper, minor marks polish out with crocus cloth (S-002 p.11-6). Bore is 50.80 mm (S-038 p.8).

name: Front caliper bleeder screws
note: With rubber cap 0259-33-693 Mazdatrix sells the bleeder 0233-33-691 (79-92 single-piston front) at 10.11 USD, in stock 2026-09-27. Bleed with a tube into a jar of fluid, front and rear circuits separately, reservoir kept at least 3/4 full (S-002 p.11-24).

name: Front caliper slide pins
note: Catalogue 'pin' 8341-33-699, qty 2, sold on its own; 8341-49-290A is 'all the pins' (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97). Grease from the pad kit goes on the pin at every pad change (S-002 p.11-5).

name: Front caliper seal kit
note: Grease 8341-49-270 is sold for it One kit does both front calipers and includes the grease: Atkins 49.95 USD, Mazdatrix 45.71 USD, both in stock 2026-09-27. The kit's two greases (orange and red) go where the 1985 figure shows; piston seal and dust boot are never reused (S-002 p.11-7).

name: Front caliper boot kit
note: Mazdatrix lists the 81-85 caliper boot kits as discontinued by Mazda (2026-09-27); Atkins' seal-kit page refers to a companion boot kit but no listing was checked. Boot and retainer come off first in the 1985 overhaul (S-002 p.11-6).

name: Front brake pad attachment (clips and shims)
note: Atkins sells the hardware kit 8341-49-290A for 79-85 12A at 69.99 USD, in stock 2026-09-27; the catalogue says it carries all the pins (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97). The anti-rattle spring and shims come out with the pads (S-002 p.11-5).

name: Front strut damper inserts
note: Catalogue DAMPER, SUB SET-FRONT FA01-49-790 (S-005 3400A-1); Mazdatrix sells the OEM successor FA24-49-790 (137.78 USD) and KYB cartridge 363010 (70.41 USD) for 81-85 non-GSL-SE cars.

name: Front strut damper set
note: Catalogue name partly illegible ("SF?, DAMPER", 34 760S) - check what it is before ordering. O-ring 8171-34-731 (EC-098-17) The partly illegible catalogue row is D-code 34760S, part 8171-34-970, qty 2, with O-ring 8171-34-731 (S-005 3400A-1); the drawing boxes it with the cap nut and seal of the oil-filled strut, so it reads as the seal/cap set. check against the parts counter.

name: Front coil springs
note: R and L differ Right F001-34-011A and left FA01-34-011A (S-005 3400A-1) have different free lengths, 325 and 334.5 mm (S-038 T:7). Racing Beat 14080 is a drop-in stiffer, 1 in lower set if stock springs are not found.

name: Front strut mounting blocks
note: Spacer FA01-34-384 and adjusting plate 1011-34-013 with it Mount FA01-34-390A is still sold new (Atkins 108 USD, Mazdatrix 128.85 USD). The thrust bearing gets a thin coat of rubber grease on both sides and the block goes back with its triangle mark where it was (S-002 13-8).

name: Front strut dust covers
note: FA01-34-015 is sold new by Mazdatrix as a strut boot (38.16 USD) and by Atkins as a front bump stop (33 USD); the catalogue calls it COVER, DUST.

name: Front bound bumpers
note: Bound bumper 8871-34-111A is no longer available from Mazda (Atkins lists it NLA).

name: Steering knuckle arms
note: Stopper bolt 0603-32-315 Removal of the knuckle arm needs puller 49 0727 575 and the tie-rod end puller 49 0118 850C (S-002 13-9).

name: Front lower arms and ball joints
note: Arm bolt 8001-28-114 (3410A-1 EC-099-15) The factory manual services the arm and ball joint only as an assembly: the ball joint is checked with a spring scale at the knuckle-arm tie-rod hole and the assembly replaced below 4 N (14 oz) (S-038 T:6, S-002 13-9). Mazda arms are NLA (Atkins lists R 8871-49-310 260 USD and L 8871-49-320 250 USD, both out of stock, also numbered FA54-49-310); Mazdatrix sells a press-in ball joint 8871-49-300 (49.74 USD) to rebuild the arm, and Atkins lists adjustable aftermarket arms (14006, 995 USD). Removal needs pullers 49 0118 850C (tie-rod end) and 49 0727 575 (knuckle arm) (S-002 13-9).

name: Front lower arm bushings
note: OEM 8173-34-460B is in stock at Mazdatrix (27.55 USD); the urethane alternative is Energy Suspension 11.3101 (pair, 12.50 USD at Atkins, reuses the outer shell). Pressed out toward the front and pressed in from the front with tool 49 0419 530, with no lubricant on bushing or bore (S-002 13-10).

name: Front ball joint dust seals
note: check on the figure that this seal is the ball joint boot OEM 8531-34-565 in stock at Mazdatrix (15.28 USD). Fill the new boot with lithium grease and press it on with installer 49 8038 785 (S-002 13-10).

name: Tension rods
note: Nuts 8871-34-133A x4, bolts 8871-34-134A x4, spacer 8871-34-135A x2 No new tension rod is listed by Atkins Rotary or Mazdatrix; what wears is the bushings (PT519). Fitted with the front end into the bracket first: set nut A, then torque nut B, then the two rear nuts at the arm (S-002 13-12).

name: Tension rod cushions
note: Retainers 8871-34-137A x4 Two per side, four per car. OEM 8871-34-136B is 12.50 USD each at Atkins (out of stock); the polyurethane set is Energy Suspension 11.7101G (23 USD, in stock). The flat face of the bushing goes toward the bracket (S-002 13-12).

name: Tension rod brackets
note: Nuts 8871-34-222 x4 (EC-099-14) Comes off and goes on together with the stabilizer bar; the bracket bolts are torqued first, then the bar and tension rod hung from it (S-002 13-11, 13-12).

name: Front stabilizer bar
note: Protector 8871-34-152 x2 (81-82) Stock bar diameter about 23 mm (Energy Suspension's bushing fitment; one owner measured 24 mm): check with calipers. Mazda no longer lists the bar; the usual replacement is Racing Beat 14100 (1.125 in OD, 229.95 USD, keeps the stock links). Removed together with the tension rod brackets (S-002 13-11). The 81-82 protector 8871-34-152 is a catalogue row only.

name: Stabilizer bushings
note: Retainers 0223-28-776 x8 Eight per car. Mazda has discontinued 1243-34-153 (Mazdatrix 4.88 USD each while stock lasts); the polyurethane 8-piece front end link bushing kit is 9.8106 (13.97 USD, Mazdatrix), or Energy Suspension 9.8123G replaces both links whole (23.99 USD, Atkins).

name: Stabilizer mounting bushings
note: Plates FA01-34-155 x2 Mazda has discontinued 8871-34-156A; the replacement is Energy Suspension 11.5101G (pair, sized for a 23 mm bar). Fitted with the split (open end) toward the front, under plate FA01-34-155, and final-tightened after the car is lowered and bounced (S-002 13-12).

name: Stabilizer link bolts
note: Spacers 0603-34-158 x2 Bolt 0603-34-157A (6.25 USD) and spacer 0603-34-158 (5.00 USD) are in stock at Atkins; discontinued at Mazdatrix. Stack per side: bolt, retainer, rubber bushing, bar, bushing, retainer, spacer, retainer, bushing, lower arm, bushing, retainer, nut (S-002 13-10, 13-12).

name: Road wheels
note: Two factory options: alloy cross-design FA01-89-376 or steel 5JX13 9965-38-503 (Sunbeam Silver K3) - check which is on the car. Balancing weights 9965-53-00xx (steel) or 9965-59-00xx (alloy), 10-60 g The 1981-83 parts catalogue lists the cross-design alloy wheel (5½-JJ x 13) for the '82 GS and GSL, while rx7.org's 1982 equipment list (S-013) gives the GS styled steel wheels (5-J x 13) and only the GSL aluminium wheels - check which is on the car.

name: Wheel nuts
note: Plated 1029-33-165 or painted 8531-33-165, by wheel fitted - check Catalogued as 'bolt, wheel set' but these are the lug nuts; 1029-33-165 is no longer available from Mazda (Atkins Rotary stocks it); open-top M12x1.5 19 mm nuts from Mazdatrix fit all RX-7 studs.

name: Wheel lock bolt and key kit
note: Alloy wheels only - check it is fitted

note: Alloy cross-design wheel only - check

note: Steel wheel only - check. Emblem 8871-37-192, rubber set 8531-37-193C

name: Tyre valves
note: TR413 TR413 is the common rubber snap-in valve for a 0.453 in (11.5 mm) rim hole, still sold everywhere.

note: 4T x 15; see parts bulletin T-2-1

name: Spare tyre (mini)
note: Factory size T135/70 D 15 at 420 kPa (60 psi); the Bridgestone Tracompa in this size was listed out of stock when checked.

name: Exhaust front pipe
note: Gaskets 1480-40-325 x2, studs N326-40-353 x4, flange nuts 8134-40-355 x4

name: Catalytic converter
note: 81-82. Plugs 1480-40-318A x2 with lock washers 8021-20-548; gasket 1480-40-375. Emission recall campaigns 23702/2370C (4000A-2 EC-104-16) - confirm whether done This is the 2-bed pellet rear converter: split air from the air control valve is injected between its two beds; a heat hazard sensor under the floor lights the overheat lamp (S-006 p69, p71).

name: Exhaust intermediate pipe
note: 81-82. Brackets 8871-40-010 and 1480-40-080B, plate 1480-40-070, spacer 1480-40-073, washer 1480-40-077, insulator 1480-40-085A, stop rubber 1114-40-108B The Mazda pipe 1480-40-200 is discontinued; Racing Beat's stainless connecting pipe 16204 (81-83) is the listed replacement.

name: Main silencer (muffler)
note: 81-82. Covers 8871-40-551 x2 Replacement: Racing Beat Power Pulse muffler 16433 for 1981-82 RX-7 ($519.75 at Mazdatrix; no gaskets or hangers).

name: Exhaust hangers
note: 1114-40-061 x2 and 1114-40-160 x5; insulators 8871-40-401 x3 and 8871-40-405A; washers 0820-40-166 x9, plates 8871-40-180 x3, hooks 1480-40-270 and 1480-40-280A Hanger rubber 1114-40-160 is available new (Atkins Rotary, fits 79-91 RX-7), superseding 0820-40-161 and 1114-40-161.

name: Air injection check valve
note: 81-82. The Weber conversion may have removed or blocked the factory air injection - confirm what is on the car Per the catalogue figure 4000A-1 (S-005 EC-103) this check valve sits at the upper end of the split-air pipe (N201-40-740A) that carries air-pump air to the catalytic converter, joined by the air hose 1480-40-728 and pre-air pipe 1480-40-750; it is not the check valve inside the air control valve. Mazda no longer lists N201-20-730; the later RX-7 check valve 1480-13-730 is a different part.

name: Air injection pipe
note: Bracket 1480-40-640A, gasket 1480-13-621. The Weber conversion may have removed or blocked the factory air injection - check what is on the car S-005 figure 4000A-1 draws it as the long split-air pipe running from the check valve (N201-20-730) back to the catalytic converter.

name: Air injection hose
note: The Weber conversion may have removed or blocked the factory air injection - check what is on the car

name: Pre-air pipe
note: The Weber conversion may have removed or blocked the factory air injection - confirm what is on the car
