note: 81-82. Washers 1480-40-815 x2, guards 8545-40-815 x4 No new or reproduction part was found in two searches; a used shield is the likely source.

name: Exhaust heat protector No. 2
note: No new or reproduction part was found; a used shield is the likely source.

name: Exhaust heat protector, upper
note: No new or reproduction part was found; a used shield is the likely source.

name: Exhaust heat protector No. 4
note: 81-82 No new or reproduction part was found; a used shield is the likely source.

name: Floor service cover plug
note: Diagram: S-005 Engine-Chassis p.104 (fig 4000A-2 exhaust system, item 58-868C 'plug, service cover'), the plug in the floor over the exhaust tunnel. The same number is still in the Mazda dealer catalogue as a 626 part, so it can be ordered through any Mazda dealer.

name: Brake pedal
note: Only A/T pedal listed after the 81 range is FA05-43-030 (control switch, A/T GSL); no 82 A/T GS entry - check the pedal on the car. Return spring 0088-41-352A, pedal pipe 0866-43-062, spacer FA16-43-063, plate 8872-43-090; the A/T fork (EC-108-27) has no part number Catalogue page 4300A-1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108, sheet 1-N9) read from the image: brake pedal FA01-43-030 '81 M/T S and GS and FA03-43-030 '81 A/T S and GS, both without control switch and both only to FB331 500001-521855; FA02-43-303 M/T GSL and FA05-43-030 A/T GSL, with control switch, no serial limit. The only A/T pedal listed past serial 521855 is FA05-43-030, so a 1982 A/T GS most likely carries it - check the pedal on the car. Suspended type; height is set by turning the stop light switch in its lock nut, free travel by the push rod lock nut (S-002 p.11-25).

name: Brake pedal bushings
note: Catalogue 'bushing, pedal' 1015-46-085, qty 2 on A/T (4 on M/T, which has the clutch pedal too), item 43022 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108). No listing found.

name: Brake pedal pad
note: Catalogue 'pad, pedal' 0225-43-028A qty 1 on A/T; M/T cars use 8871-43-028A x2 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108). The same number is still sold as a B2200 pedal pad by Mazda dealers (Jim Ellis listing, page not opened).

name: Brake pedal stopper rubbers
note: Catalogue 'rubber, stopper' B001-43-029, qty 2 on A/T, 3 on M/T (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108). No listing found.

name: Stop lamp switch
note: Catalogue lists 2 - check how many are fitted and what the second one switches The switch position sets brake pedal height (190 +5/-0 mm, S-038 T:6; procedure S-002 11-25). Mazdatrix sells H003-66-490A as the 82-88 brake light switch for cars with cruise control, which may explain the catalogue qty 2 - check.

name: Foot rest
note: Diagram: S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108 (fig 4300A-1, item 43-041 'rest, foot'). The bare rest is not listed by Atkins Rotary or Mazdatrix; only its pad FA01-43-042 is sold new (two searches, 2026-09-27).

name: Foot rest pad
note: Diagram: S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108 (fig 4300A-1, item 43-042 'pad, foot rest', GS and GSL). New Mazda FA01-43-042 at Atkins Rotary, 6.75 USD, in stock 2026-09-27, fits 1981-85.

name: Brake fluid reservoir
note: Seated on elbow joint bushings 0305-49-686B x2 The two rubber seals between the reservoir and the master cylinder (0305-49-686B) are 4.50 USD each at Atkins Rotary, in stock. Keep the reservoir at least 3/4 full while bleeding (S-002 11-24). No listing for the reservoir FA07-49-680 itself was found.

name: Brake fluid reservoir cap
note: Atkins Rotary sells B093-49-580 as the 72-91 master cylinder cap (15.25 USD, in stock); Mazdatrix lists the 79-85 brake fluid cap under GA02-49-580B, discontinued by Mazda. Check which number the cap on the car carries.

name: Brake fluid level indicator
note: The level warning switch A float switch in the reservoir cap: closes BR to B (ground X-13) at low level and lights the 1.4 W BRAKE warning lamp, the same lamp the parking brake switch lights (S-001 p16).

name: Master cylinder parts set
note: Joint bolt G001-49-652 Not stocked by Atkins Rotary (they list only the 84-88 kit HA18-49-610A); an rx7club thread names G001-49-610 as the 81-83 S/GS kit and FA18-49-610 as the GSL kit. Spareto cross-references G001-49-610 to Frenkit 120058, Autofren Seinsa D1485 and ERT 200334 (about 5 EUR each, 28-day dispatch).

name: Master cylinder inner parts kit
note: Frenkit 120058 lists G001-49-640 among its OE numbers; its piston diameter of 20.6 mm matches the 20.64 mm bore.

name: Brake booster repair kit
note: No listing found for F001-49-720. The factory kit furnishes the silicone grease that goes on the valve rod and plunger, the whole reaction disc, the diaphragm's outer bead and both seal lips (S-002 11-22..23); the valve rod and plunger are serviced only as an assembly (S-002 11-21).

name: Brake booster vacuum hoses and pipes
note: None of the four catalogued factory lines survive; a new vacuum line runs from the brake booster solenoid directly to one independent rotor's intake manifold, confirmed 2026-09-26. The factory hose carried a press-fit one-way check valve marked with a flow arrow; air must pass from the booster end to the engine end only, and a bad valve is replaced with the hose (S-002 11-20). Check whether the new line fitted since the Weber conversion carries a check valve. Used OEM two-piece hose sets with clamps sell at Autopartone (30 USD).

name: Brake pipe valve (proportioning valve)
note: Holder FA07-43-750 Catalogue 'valve, brake pipe' FA07-43-900 on both the drum (S, GS) and disc (GSL) piping pages for '81 and '82; the '83 GSL takes FA48-43-900 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). The 1985 manual calls it the differential proportioning valve, sits it on the front pipe between master cylinder and the front and rear lines, and says to match the identification mark on the body when reconnecting the pipes (S-002 p.11-2, 11-26). Owners describe one inlet from the master cylinder and outlets marked F (front) and an arrow (rear), a large hex cap with a copper washer over the piston (rx7club threads). No split point or ratio found in any source.

name: Front flexible brake hoses
note: Clips 8001-43-635 x2, 0136-43-635 x3 Atkins sells GA02-43-980 for 81-83 12A at 49.95 USD, in stock 2026-09-27, same hose both sides, two per car. Mazdatrix lists GA02-43-980 as discontinued by Mazda and sells DOT stainless kits instead (81-85 drum 14524-DOT, 68.64 USD). Union torque 25-35 N·m (S-038 p.10). Never let the caliper hang on the hose (S-002 p.9-5).

name: Rear flexible brake hose
note: Clips 8001-43-635 x2 Catalogue 'hose no.1, flexible' FA07-43-820, one per car on the drum-brake piping (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111); mazda-parts.com still lists FA07-43-820 as a flex hose (page blocked, from the search index). Mazdatrix's 81-85 drum DOT stainless kit 14524-DOT (68.64 USD) replaces it with the front hoses. Union torque 25-35 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, front (from master cylinder)
note: Catalogue 'pipe, brake-front' FA07-43-360, item 45250, master cylinder to the valve (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, front right
note: 81-82 '81 and '82 models only; the '83 pipe is FA42-45-280 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, front left
note: Catalogue item 45320, no year split (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, rear (FA07-43-370)
note: Protectors 8871-43-785A, 8595-43-609 x7 (to FB331 610655; later serials differ - check), rubber screw 8871-43-608, clips 8173-45-903 x2 The seven 8595-43-609 protectors are listed for '81 and '82 to FB331 610655; the disc-brake page uses six with spacers 1114-43-608B and cushions 1114-43-609A (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, rear (FA54-45-360)
note: Catalogue item 45360A, the same number on the drum and disc piping pages (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, rear axle left
note: Drum-brake axle pipe; the disc-brake page uses FA18-43-650 instead (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Brake pipe, rear axle right
note: Drum-brake axle pipe; the disc-brake page uses FA18-43-660 instead (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

name: Headlamp lid, R and L
note: fasteners and trim: lid spring 8871-51-401, protector 8871-51-403, cushion rubber 0866-52-451, stopper screw 8871-51-411 Left lid 8871-51-621A: NLA new, Atkins has remaining NOS stock (185 USD). Lid height is set by the adjusting screw and lock nut against the stop rubber (S-002 14-18).

name: Headlamp lid hinge, R and L
note: fasteners: tilting-hinge shims 8871-51-405 (6), hinge bolts 8871-51-431, bolt bushings 8871-51-432, hinge nuts 8871-51-433 (4 each) After replacing a hinge, redo the lid up-down adjustment; the link snaps onto the ball pivot by finger pressure, not pliers (S-002 14-17, S-045 15:2).

name: Headlamp assembly (halogen), R and L
note: GS halogen set. Aim with the adjust screws. fasteners: adjust screws 3958-51-021 (4), adjust springs 8871-51-021, retaining rings 8871-51-033, screw grommets 0483-66-061A. LED units sit in the factory buckets, confirmed 2026-09-26. Sealed beam is held by the retaining ring (screws, rotate counterclockwise to remove) and aimed with the two adjusting screws (S-002 14-16, S-045 15:1).

name: Headlamp retractor motor and link assembly, R and L
note: fasteners: motor brackets 8871-51-932 (R) 8871-51-942 (L) Used 81-83 motors are sold complete with relay, cover boot and mounting bolts. After fitting, set the motor link at its lowest (automatic stop) position with the knob and slide the motor fore/aft on its bolts to adjust the lid (S-002 14-18).

name: Headlamp retractor rods and link levers
note: per side: motor rod, rod A, rod B and a link lever Rod B 8871-51-936 is in stock at Atkins (36.95 USD); rod A 8871-51-934 is NLA (Atkins NOS, includes bushings). A printable TPU bushing for the linkage is in the CAD library.

name: Headlamp manual raise knob
note: the manual raise knobs work The knob sits on the retractor motor shaft under the boot; disconnect the battery negative before turning it (S-045 15:1, S-002 14-16).

name: Headlamp retractor motor boot
note: The boot is the cover taken off to reach the manual control knob (S-002 14-16).

name: Headlamp retractor relay
note: check: where the two relays are mounted S-001 p.20 draws the relay inside each retractor motor unit (dashed box): coil fed through the motor limit switch, contact switches WR to the motor. So one relay per motor, on the motor - check. The 83-85 relay FA01-51-939 (Atkins, out of stock) is a different part.

name: Front combination lamp, R and L
note: fasteners: cord protector 8545-51-516 S-001 Section F: F-05 (LH) / F-06 (RH) front turn and parking light, 3-pin connector RG (parking 8 W), GR/GO (turn 27 W), B (LH to ground X-13, RH to X-14). Lamp set FA01-89-667 (L) is NLA at Mazdatrix; the Thingiverse 1157 housing (125x36x29 mm, author unsure which lamp) may be this lamp's body - check against the part.

name: Front combination lamp bulb, 1157 (27/8 W)
note: Trade 1157: S-8 glass, BAY15d double-contact indexed bayonet, 12.8 V 2.10 A (27 W) / 14 V 0.59 A (8 W); front position uses the 27 W filament for turn (GR/GO) and 8 W for parking (RG).

name: Front combination lamp lens, R and L
note: lens gasket FA01-51-063 Amber lens; FA01-51-071 (L) was in stock new at Mazdatrix (USD 41.06) in 2026-09; FA01-51-061 (R) seen new and used on eBay.

name: Front side turn lamp, R and L
note: Catalogue calls it 'side turn lamp' but on the 1982 US car S-001 wires it as the front side marker, F-12 (LH) / F-13 (RH): RG from the light switch and B, lit with the parking lamps, not flashing. FA01-89-668 (L) NLA at Mazdatrix.

name: Front side turn lamp bulb, 194 (3.8 W)
note: Trade 194: T-3 1/4 glass wedge, 14 V 0.27 A (3.8 W), 2 MSCP.

name: Front side turn lamp lens, R and L
note: FA01-51-131 (L) listed NLA (discontinued by Mazda) at Mazdatrix; used only.

name: Rear combination lamp, R and L
note: fasteners: protector FA01-51-159 S-001 Section F: F-07 (LH) / F-08 (RH), 6-cavity connector GR/GO turn, RW back-up, one cavity unused, G stop (from stop light checker F-03), RG tail, B ground to X-15; each side holds two 1157 (stop/tail) and two 1156 (turn, back-up). Lamp sets FA01-89-664/669 NLA at Mazdatrix; a 3D scan of the RH housing exists.

name: Rear combination lamp bulb, 1156 (27 W)
note: Trade 1156: S-8 glass, BA15s single-contact bayonet, 12.8 V 2.10 A (27 W), 32 MSCP; one per side for turn (GR/GO) and one for back-up (RW).

name: Rear combination lamp bulb, 1157 (27/8 W)
note: Two per side (S-001 '27/8W x2'): 27 W filaments on G (stop, via stop light checker), 8 W filaments on RG (tail).

name: Rear combination lamp lens, R and L
note: lens gaskets FA01-51-153A (R) FA01-51-163A (L) FA01-51-151D (R) and FA01-51-161D (L) listed NLA (discontinued by Mazda) at Mazdatrix; used only.

name: License lamp
note: S-001 Section F: F-04 license light LH and RH, two single-wire connectors RG (from the light switch tail bus) and B (ground X-15), 6 W each.

name: License lamp bulb (6 W)
note: Mazda 9970-03-060T is 12 V 6 W; a bulb-chart site (S-019) gives trade 89 (13 V 0.58 A, BA15s, G-6), which does not match 6 W exactly - check the base and trade number on the removed bulb.

name: License lamp lens
note: lens gasket 3874-66-373 3874-66-371 fits all 81-85 RX-7, two per car; listed No Longer Available at Atkins Rotary (was USD 8.25).

name: Rear side turn lamp, R and L
note: The catalogue calls it 'side turn lamp', but S-001 p22 wires it as the rear side marker (F-14 LH / F-15 RH): lit steady from the RG tail bus with the parking lights, not flashed by the turn circuit. Grounds at X-15 (check on the car).

name: Rear side turn lamp bulb, 194 (3.8 W)
note: Trade number 194 (T-3 1/4 wedge, W2.1x9.5d). Factory rating 12 V 3.8 W (S-005 BI-036-05, S-001 p22); a 194 is 14 V 0.27 A, 2 MSCP. Candela catalogue saved in datasheets/PT609.

name: Rear side turn lamp lens, R and L
note: Atkins Rotary sold replica R (FA01-51-551) and L (FA01-51-561) lenses at 20 USD each, now NLA; used OEM lenses turn up (autopart3, red lens, code 232-41786R), so plan on used ones.

name: Cargo room lamp
note: S-001 p26 (H-11 luggage compartment light, 5 W): LY feed, constant from the X-04 15 A fuse via X-03; RB return to H-12 luggage compartment light switch, which closes to ground (check on the car). Works with the key out. Catalogue: GS & GSL only.

name: Cargo room lamp bulb (5 W festoon)
note: Mazda 0000-11-3022 is still sold as a current Mazda cargo lamp bulb (about 2.29 USD). No source gives the festoon length: measure the old bulb before buying another.

name: Instrument cluster
note: '82 cluster; no whole-cluster number is listed. fasteners: spring nuts 8871-55-425 and 0820-56-905 S-001 p16: the cluster is fed GY from the 10 A meter fuse (IG) and grounded B to X-13 through two 13-cavity round connectors X-05 and X-06; the oil-level, stop-light and alternator warning lamps are linked by diodes inside the printed plate so the alternator lamp circuit also lights them (bulb check). 1982 cluster carries an oil pressure gauge and a voltmeter beside fuel/temp.

name: Meter case
note: 1985 manual (S-002 15-22) disassembly order: front lens, plate, voltmeter and oil gauge, tachometer, speedometer, fuel and temp gauge, warning lights lens, meter case, printed plate, bulbs; 1982 order not given, check.

name: Meter hood
note: hood springs 8531-55-412 (2)

name: Tachometer
note: Electronic tachometer: GY feed, B ground, signal YG from the trailing ignition coil negative (S-001 p16, section B); the K-008 fault analysis traces its flicker to the shared X-13 ground.

name: Speedometer
note: '82 unit. trip reset knob 1907-75-102A Cable-driven; 1985 manual says a fluctuating or dead needle is checked by removing the cable first, and only if the cable is good is the speedometer replaced.

name: Speedometer cable
note: cable clip 8173-18-762 Used OEM FB cables are sold by salvage specialists; the listed fit claims 1979-85 both transmissions, check length against the car.

name: Fuel and water temperature gauge
note: Both are thermal (bimetal heater-coil) gauges fed from PT624 and grounded through their resistive senders: fuel on Y to C-01, temperature on YW to C-02 (S-001 p16). Factory test: substitute the sender with checker 49 0839 285 and wait 2 minutes.

name: Meter voltage regulator
note: feeds the fuel and temperature gauge S-001 p16: input GY (IG), output to the fuel and water temperature gauges only, ground B via X-05; the oil pressure gauge, tachometer and voltmeter take GY directly, unregulated. Output voltage is not given in any source opened.

name: Panel illumination dimmer resistor
note: knob FA01-55-492, ring nut FA01-55-493 E-05 rheostat (S-001 p20): RG in from the light switch tail circuit, RL out to the dimmed illumination lamps (meter, heater, select lever, switch panel, lighter), B to X-13 via X-02; the radio and stereo lamps take RG directly and are not dimmed.

name: Meter illumination and warning bulb, 194 (3.4 W)
note: Trade 194: 14 V 0.27 A T3-1/4 miniature wedge W2.1x9.5d (Eiko datasheet); factory rates it 3.4 W. On the 1982 cluster it lights the meter illumination and the oil level, high beam and retractor indicators (S-001 p16, p20).

name: Meter warning bulb, 74 (1.4 W)
note: Trade 74: 14 V 0.1 A T1-3/4 sub-miniature wedge W2.1x4.9d (Eiko datasheet); factory 1.4 W, used for the brake, stop light, alternator and coolant level warning lamps (S-001 p16).

name: Meter bulb socket (1316)
note: check: which socket takes which bulb S-005 fig 5540A-1 (BI p49) draws socket 55261 with bulb 75115, the 194 12 V 3.4 W (PT626): this is the socket for the 194 bulbs. The same Mazda number is still listed by Mazda USA as a tachometer socket for the 1986 323; the page refused an automated read, so availability is unconfirmed.

name: Meter bulb socket (3625)
note: check: which socket takes which bulb S-005 fig 5540A-1 (BI p49) draws socket 55261A with bulb 75115A, the 74 1.4 W (PT627): this is the socket for the 74 bulbs. The catalogue lists 6 of these sockets but 8 of the 74 bulbs, so two 74 bulbs sit somewhere else (check on the car). No live listing for 3625-55-261 was found.

name: Warning chime
note: S-001 p.26/p.16: a two-wire chime (connector X-06) fed LY constant off the 15 A fuse; its G side is switched to ground by the Control Processing Unit (key reminder, lights-off) and by the C-10 oscillator (coolant/oil level warnings). The 1985 manual (S-002 p.15-12) calls it the buzzer in the meter.

name: Cigar lighter
note: short cord FA01-66-251; heat shield 8871-66-242, protector FA01-66-241 S-001 p.26: H-09 connector LY (element feed, constant, 15 A fuse), RL (illumination bulb, from the panel light control) and B (ground to X-13 via X-02). No 1981-83 lighter listing found; 84-85 and 86-92 (FB01-66-250) lighters are sold, fit unconfirmed.

name: Cigar lighter illumination ring
note: Carries the PT633 bulb; the ring itself has no terminal. Bulb wattage is SP-196.

name: Cigar lighter bulb (3.4 W)
note: 3.4 W (SP-196, S-001 p.20) on RL from E-05 panel light control, ground B; so it dims with the dash. Trade number not found in any source; check the bulb type in the car.

name: Power mirror remote control switch
note: works the power mirror heads (PT032); the record says this factory switch is dead S-001 p.28 draws each mirror as ONE motor plus ONE solenoid (LgY-B), not two motors as windows-mirrors.md says; the 1985 manual (S-002 p.15-42) draws the same. The switch energises the solenoid for up/down and reverses the motor. 1982 feed is WG constant (10 A), 1985 is L from ACC.

name: Fuel lid opener switch
note: works the fuel-door solenoid S-001 p.26: H-15 is a 4-cavity connector with two used, LR (20 A constant) and GB to the H-16 solenoid, which grounds at X-15; a momentary contact joins LR to GB.

name: Motor antenna switch
note: S-001 p.24: G-13 'power antenna switch (without radio)', two wires LG and B; it grounds the LG coil side of the G-01 power antenna relay. Cars with the factory radio drive LG from the radio instead.

name: Rear wiper switch
note: on the console. confirm: the rear wiper may be optional equipment; look for a wiper on the hatch glass S-001 p.18: D-06 has B, BG and LW: one contact grounds BG (rear wiper motor D-05), the other grounds LW (rear washer motor D-04); both motors are fed L on their own 10 A ignition fuse.

name: Combination switch (steering column)
note: the GS switch without cruise. fasteners: band holder BA29-66-129, band-holder bolt 8182-66-124 Atkins Rotary lists FA01-66-120 new at 358.95 USD (2026-09) and the turn-signal switch alone as FA01-66-122. On S-001 it appears as E-01 (light/dimmer/passing, plus the GL horn lead), F-02 (turn/hazard) and D-03 (wiper/washer).

name: Light and turn switch
note: New FA01-66-122 still sold by Atkins Rotary (99.75 USD, in stock, 81-83 only). Covers E-01 (light, dimmer, passing, horn contact) and F-02 (turn and hazard) on S-001. On S-001 p20 the high-beam indicator hangs on RL and the 1985 manual labels RL high and RY low, the reverse of headlights-popups-illumination.md: check on the car.

name: Wiper and washer switch
note: Atkins sells an 81-83 wiper switch as BA30-66-135 (95.00 USD), not the catalogue's BA30-66-123; whether it supersedes it is unconfirmed. S-001 p.18 connector D-03: B, LO, LY / LR, LG, LW.

name: Turn signal cancel cam
note: Still sold new by Atkins Rotary (5.99 USD, fits all 81-85). The printable canceler bridge in the CAD library is the switch-side part the cam strikes.

name: Horn contact
note: S-001 p.22: the horn switch is a ground-side contact on GL through E-01 to the F-16 horn relay coil; it carries only relay coil current.

name: Kick-down switch
note: at the accelerator pedal Screw-in plunger switch with a lock nut at the accelerator pedal, two single-pin connectors (B-32 on S-001): BW feed from the ignition switch, BR out to the kick-down solenoid. Mazda still lists 2691-18-660 (catalogued for the 626 as well).

name: Door switch, R and L
note: adjust washers 0209-66-821 S-001 p.26: single-terminal switch on RY that grounds through its body; RY runs to the interior/spot light and the Control Processing Unit. New genuine B001-66-540 is still listed (about 7.50 USD).

name: Parking lamp switch
note: check: what this switch senses and where it sits (it may be the parking-brake warning switch at the lever); the catalogue lists it with the door and kick-down switches Mazda's current catalogue names -66-450 parts 'Switch, parking lamp' and sells them as the park brake warning switch (GJ6G-66-450), which supports this being the S-001 C-04 parking brake switch (one BR wire, to ground). Still check on the car.

name: Power window switch
note: the car has manual windows and no window wiring On 1982 power-window cars each door has its own 4-pin switch (I-06 LH: RL, B, GL, BL; I-07 RH: R, B, G, BL) on a 30 A IG fuse (S-001 p28); FA03-66-350A is one switch that serves either side, still sold new (Atkins, 2026).

name: Horn, high tone
note: Single-wire horn: GY from the horn relay F-16, grounded through its bracket; shares the 15 A fuse with the stop lights (S-001 p22). The 1980 manual sets each horn to 3.0 +/- 0.5 A at 12 V with its adjusting screw.

name: Horn, low tone
note: Single-wire horn: GY from the horn relay F-16, grounded through its bracket; shares the 15 A fuse with the stop lights (S-001 p22). Which of F-09/F-10 is the low tone is not shown in S-001; check on the car.

name: Auto cruise control
note: confirm: the factory GS came without cruise (its combination switch is the W/O A.C.C. one); check the engine bay for an actuator and the console for a main switch The 1982 system (S-001 p14, section B): main switch B-31 on a 10 A IG fuse (Br) feeds BrB to the unit B-25 and the actuator B-28; stop B-26 and clutch B-27 switches (Br/RY) cancel; set/coast/resume on the combination switch B-30; vehicle speed switch B-29 (BR).

name: Cruise control actuator
note: spring 8871-13-087A, connector 1700-13-945A, pipe FA02-66-361, protectors FA03-66-312. confirm: the factory GS came without cruise (its combination switch is the W/O A.C.C. one); check the engine bay for an actuator and the console for a main switch A vacuum servo with three solenoid coils (VAC, VENT 1, VENT 2) on a common BrB feed (S-001 p14; coil names from the 1985 manual).

name: Cruise control cable
note: confirm: the factory GS came without cruise (its combination switch is the W/O A.C.C. one); check the engine bay for an actuator and the console for a main switch The actuator inner cable pulls the carburettor throttle lever; free play is set at an adjusting nut (1985 manual 15-51).

name: Cruise control unit
note: confirm: the factory GS came without cruise (its combination switch is the W/O A.C.C. one); check the engine bay for an actuator and the console for a main switch 13-cavity connector B-25 (12 wires, one cavity unused) (S-001 p14); the 1985 manual tests it through its 13-pin plug with the ACC checker 49 9200 010.

name: Cruise control set switch
note: on the combination switch of cruise cars. confirm: the factory GS came without cruise (its combination switch is the W/O A.C.C. one); check the engine bay for an actuator and the console for a main switch Three momentary contacts SET (BY), COAST (RW) and RESUME (BrW), each to a common B ground, at connector B-30 (S-001 p14).

name: Cruise main switch knob
note: the drawing shows it on the GSL-only main switch FA03-66-340. confirm: the factory GS came without cruise (its combination switch is the W/O A.C.C. one); check the engine bay for an actuator and the console for a main switch The main switch it caps carries a 3.4 W indicator lamp (S-001 p14).

name: Radio, Clarion AM/FM full control
note: factory '82 GS unit. fasteners: screws 0222-66-865A (colour variant 00). check: whether the head unit fitted now is this factory radio S-001 p24 (G-04): switched feed LgW comes through the stereo/deck position G-03 from LR (X-04 20 A, ACC), illumination RG 3.4 W, LG to the power antenna relay; speakers LG/LW (front LH) and LY/LR (front RH) on a 4-pole plug; DIN cord to the main amp. Shaft-type radio, not DIN size (src-wrighthere-stereo). check: what bridges G-03 on a GS with no tape deck.

name: Radio knob
note: Knobs pull off the radio shafts; the 1980 manual removes the knobs, then the shaft nuts and bezel (S-045 section 15, other-car).

name: Radio DIN cord
note: check: FA09-66-910A from serial FB331..633361, FA05-66-910A before; read the VIN serial Joins the radio to the main amplifier (S-001 p24 'DIN CODE' between G-04 and G-08); carries the rear-channel signal. Pinout for '82 not given; 1985 layout recorded as other-car.

name: Radio earth wire
note: Radio case ground; S-001 p24 draws the radio grounded through its case, not a harness pin. check the earth point on the car.

name: Tuner ornament (blank for cars without a radio)
note: only on cars without a radio; this car has a head unit

name: Main amplifier, Clarion 5 W x 2
note: check: the factory amplifier behind the head unit is this one S-001 p24 (G-08): power L from connector G-07 (LR, X-04 20 A), outputs LR/LO to rear LH (G-09) and LW/LB to rear RH (G-10); drives only the rear speakers, the radio drives the fronts. 1985 manual's equivalent 'System 3' puts the 5 W x 2 amp under the rear storage area (S-002 15-63, other-car).

name: Front power amplifier, Clarion 25 W x 2
note: check: the catalogue lists it for GS and GSL with no year and an -83 number; check whether a second amplifier is fitted The '82 GS wiring (S-001 p24) shows only one amplifier, the 5 W x 2 main amp; no front power amp appears, so this part is likely not on a '82 GS. check on the car.

name: Front speaker, 4 in dual cone
note: Driven directly by the radio: LH G-05 LG/LW, RH G-06 LY/LR (S-001 p24), LH through connector X-02. Factory check (1985 manual, other-car): impedance across one channel should equal the rated impedance, and infinite to body (S-002 15-67, 15-71).

name: Speaker grille
note: No first-gen grille listed at Atkins Rotary (Sept 2026); used only.

name: Rear speaker
note: check: which is fitted, the 5 in single cone (0000-81-0643) or the 6.5 in coaxial (0000-81-5216-01) The '82 brochure gives two-way coaxial rear speakers only to the GSL (S-004 p15), so the GS rear is most likely the 5 in single cone 0000-81-0643. Driven by the main amp: LH G-09 LR/LO, RH G-10 LW/LB (S-001 p24). check on the car.

name: Speaker cord
note: for the full-control radio Catalogue fig 6680A-2 (S-005 BI p105) draws 66975 running from the dash round the cabin to the rear speakers; it carries the amp-to-rear-speaker circuits LR/LO/LW/LB of S-001 p24. check.

name: Speaker short cord
note: check: fitted only from serial FB331..633361; read the VIN serial Drawn in the FB331..633361- inset of fig 6680A-2 (S-005 BI p105) next to the amplifier.

name: Audio diode
note: '82 and '83 models. check: where the two diodes sit in the harness Catalogue fig 6680A-2 (S-005 BI p105) draws the diode (67242A) plugged into the harness at the HEAD LAMP RETRACTOR MOTOR, so the two sit one at each pop-up motor, filed under audio (likely radio noise suppression). check on the car.

name: Power antenna
note: fasteners: band FA01-66-946, brackets FA02-66-941 and FA02-66-942, insulation rubber 1757-15-312, protector 8572-51-051. confirm: where it is mounted S-001 page 24 (section G) draws it as G-01 relay, G-02 motor and G-13 switch, fed from the 20 A LR fuse on the switched L line from the ignition switch; the 1985 manual puts the assembly behind the right rear trunk side trim (other year, check where it is on this car). The complete FB assembly FA01-66-930C appears to be no longer available; the 1984-85 FA42-66-930A still lists at Mazda dealers.

name: Antenna pole (mast)
note: Sellers list the mast as FA42-66-941A for 1981-85 (the pole with its nylon drive cord); FB masts do not interchange with 1979-80 masts. The brittle nylon drive cord is the usual failure. Whether FA42-66-941A replaces FA01-66-941A needs confirming. Part of the power antenna, which may not be fitted: confirm.

name: Antenna feeder cable
note: 1985 manual: to remove the antenna, take out the right rear trunk side trim, then disconnect the feeder and the connector (other year; check). Part of the power antenna, which may not be fitted: confirm.

name: Antenna relay
note: S-001 G-01 has six wires: LR, R, LY and B on one side, LG and L on the other. The coil runs from LR through a diode to LG, and LG is grounded by the radio or by the G-13 antenna switch. A used FB relay was listed under the number FA01-67-740, which differs from the catalogue's FA01-66-947 (check). Part of the power antenna, which may not be fitted: confirm.

name: Antenna bi-metal switch
note: No test value was found in any source. An rx7club thread (1985 context) says a switch that responds to voltage turns the motor off at the end of travel, which suggests the bi-metal switch is the thermal cut-out at the end of travel (check). Part of the power antenna, which may not be fitted: confirm.

name: Windshield washer tank assembly
note: fasteners: tank bracket 8545-53-225, protector 0866-67-156

name: Washer tank
note: Atkins Rotary sells a 1979-83 12A washer bottle as 0317-67-511A (35 USD, without the cap), a different number from the catalogue's 2522-76-671A; check it fits before buying.

name: Washer nozzle
note: packing 1011-67-511B, clip 1011-67-515B Still sold new as 1011-67-510A for all 1979-83 RX-7s (Atkins Rotary, 21 USD, in stock); the nozzle gasket 1011-67-511B is sold separately.

name: Wiper motor
note: Two-speed permanent-magnet motor with separate LO and HI brushes, common brush on L (IG feed), switched on the ground side by the combination switch; internal cam park (auto-stop) switch on LB grounds the circuit away from park and joins LB to L at park (S-001 p18, S-045 15:4). 1980 factory test: low 43-60 rpm, high 62-95 rpm, under 4 A no load (other-car; check).

name: Wiper motor brush holder
note: Holds the three brushes (common, LO, HI); worn brushes are the factory's first cause of abnormal wiper noise (S-002 15-43).

name: Wiper motor gear box
note: Gear box carries the worm gear and the cam-operated park switch (terminal LB) that gives auto-stop (S-001 p18).

name: Wiper motor parts set
note: newer parts info: Mazda service bulletin 109/83

name: Wiper linkage and pivots
note: link 8871-76-601B, frame 8871-76-602B. pivot parts: outer bushings 8871-76-604A, inner bushings 8871-76-605A and 8871-76-603A, seal caps 8871-76-655A, cap nuts 8871-76-657, cup washers 8871-76-656A, cover 1175-76-609. fasteners: nuts 0727-87-844, grommets 0824-87-846, band 0305-87-956, clip 0208-66-944A Printable replacement linkage bushings and motor mounts exist (cad rows rx7-sa22c-wiper-refresh-kit-printables-grantd, fb-wiper-grommet-printables-lovc). Factory: insufficient grease in the link joints causes wiper noise (S-002 15-43).

name: Wiper arm
note: arm cover 8871-76-641; rubber washers 0866-67-301A, spacers 0866-67-302, cap washers 1011-67-375 Park the blades at the upper (park) position before removing the arms (S-045 15:3).

name: Wiper blade
note: Aftermarket fitment lists 17 in blades for 1982, driver and passenger (check by measuring the fitted blade).

name: Rear wiper motor
note: motor cover 1480-67-435, bracket 1480-76-624A, spacer 1480-67-436. pivot parts: bushings 1480-67-606, 1480-76-607, 1480-76-623, seal cap 0212-66-371. fasteners: nuts 8871-62-635A 0212-66-372A 1480-76-626 0259-87-134, washers 8871-62-636A 1029-76-621 0702-87-132. confirm: the rear wiper may be optional equipment; look for a wiper on the hatch glass The 1982 US brochure (S-004 p15) lists the rear-window wiper/washer as GSL standard equipment and not for S or GS, so on this GS it is either a dealer/optional fit or absent - check on the hatch. New motor 1480-67-450C is no longer available from Mazda (Atkins, 2026); used only.

name: Rear wiper motor gear box
note: confirm: the rear wiper may be optional equipment; look for a wiper on the hatch glass

name: Rear wiper motor brush holder plate
note: confirm: the rear wiper may be optional equipment; look for a wiper on the hatch glass

name: Rear wiper motor brush
note: confirm: the rear wiper may be optional equipment; look for a wiper on the hatch glass Brushes are the wear item the 1985 manual names for abnormal wiper noise (S-002 sec 15 p15-43).

name: Rear wiper motor stator yoke
